description:
**HR Intern**

Location: Chembur, Mumbai

Work Mode: On\-site

Duration: 3 Months

Stipend: ₹10,000 per month

Joining: Immediate Joiners Only

**About Zouk**

Zouk is a Modern Indian Lifestyle Brand that brings together contemporary and traditional

design to create products that effortlessly define a modern Indian classic.

Proudly Indian and 100% PETA\-approved vegan, Zouk creates premium bags, wallets and

footwear inspired by India's rich cultural heritage. Backed by leading investors including

Stellaris Venture Partners and Titan Capital, Zouk is on a mission to build the next big brand in

the Indian consumer space.

At Zouk, we believe that building a great brand starts with building a great team. We’re looking

for a driven and enthusiastic HR Intern to join our team and get hands\-on experience in

recruitment and people operations.

**About the Role**

As an HR Intern, you will work closely with the HR team across campus recruitment,

candidate coordination, interview scheduling and recruitment operations.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interacting with people, is highly organised, and wants

to understand how hiring works in a fast\-growing consumer brand.

What You’ll Do

\- Support the HR team with end\-to\-end recruitment coordination for various roles.

\- Assist with campus recruitment initiatives, including identifying colleges, reaching out

to placement cells and coordinating campus hiring activities.

\- Build and maintain relationships with college placement teams and student

coordinators.

\- Coordinate with candidates throughout the interview process and ensure a smooth

candidate experience.

\- Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and interviewers, managing

calendars and follow\-ups.

\- Maintain and regularly update candidate trackers and recruitment databases.

\- Follow up with candidates and interviewers to ensure timely closure of interview rounds.

\- Assist in preparing interview schedules, candidate information and recruitment reports.

\- Support the HR team with other day\-to\-day recruitment and people\-related activities.

\- Help improve and streamline recruitment processes wherever possible.

**What We’re Looking For**

\- Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

\- Highly organised with good attention to detail.

\- Comfortable speaking with candidates, colleges and internal stakeholders.

\- Good follow\-up skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

\- Comfortable working with Excel / Google Sheets.

\- Proactive, enthusiastic and willing to take ownership.

\- Someone who enjoys working in a fast\-paced startup environment.

**Why Join Zouk?**

\- Get hands\-on exposure to Talent Acquisition and campus recruitment.

\- Work closely with the HR team and understand how hiring works in a growing consumer

brand.

\- Gain experience in managing candidates and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

\- Work on live recruitment projects and take ownership of meaningful responsibilities.

\- Be part of a young, collaborative and fast\-paced team building a proudly Indian brand.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 per month

title: Assistant Restaurant Manager
description:
Assistant Restaurant Manager (ARM)

**Company:** AMA Café  
**Location:** Rajpur, Dehradun, Uttarakhand  
**Department:** Operations  
**Reports To:** Restaurant Manager / Operations Head  
**Experience:** 3–6 years in F\&B / Restaurant Operations

About the Role

AMA Café is looking for a **hands\-on and customer\-focused Assistant Restaurant Manager (ARM)** to support the smooth and efficient functioning of our Rajpur, Dehradun outlet.

The ARM will be responsible for assisting with daily restaurant operations, supervising the service team, maintaining high standards of hospitality and guest experience, ensuring SOP compliance, supporting sales targets, and coordinating with the Kitchen, Bar, Bakery, Store, HR, and Accounts teams.

The ideal candidate should have strong leadership skills, excellent communication, a passion for hospitality, and the ability to manage operations in a fast\-paced restaurant environment.

Key Responsibilities1\. Restaurant Operations

* Assist the Restaurant Manager in managing the overall day\-to\-day operations of the outlet.
* Supervise restaurant operations during assigned shifts and ensure smooth service.
* Ensure proper opening and closing procedures are followed.
* Maintain high standards of service, cleanliness, hygiene, grooming, and restaurant presentation.
* Ensure all operational SOPs and company policies are followed.
* Ensure proper manpower deployment across service areas.
* Coordinate closely with the Kitchen, Bar, Bakery, and Store teams for smooth operations.

2\. Team Management

* Supervise, guide, and motivate the restaurant team during shifts.
* Allocate duties and responsibilities effectively.
* Conduct daily pre\-shift briefings and communicate operational priorities.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, grooming, discipline, and performance.
* Train and coach team members on service standards and SOPs.
* Support the Restaurant Manager in team performance reviews and development.
* Identify manpower requirements and coordinate with the Restaurant Manager and HR.

3\. Guest Experience \& Hospitality

* Ensure every guest receives a warm, professional, and consistent hospitality experience.
* Maintain high standards of guest service throughout the dining experience.
* Handle guest queries, feedback, and complaints professionally and promptly.
* Take ownership of guest concerns and ensure appropriate resolution.
* Monitor table service, order accuracy, service speed, food presentation, and overall guest satisfaction.
* Build positive relationships with regular guests.

4\. Sales \& Business Performance

* Support the Restaurant Manager in achieving daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Monitor sales performance during shifts.
* Encourage effective upselling and suggestive selling by the service team.
* Ensure promotions and special offers are implemented correctly.
* Monitor table turnover and service efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales and guest engagement.

5\. Inventory \& Cost Control

* Monitor the usage of food, beverages, packaging, crockery, cutlery, and other operational supplies.
* Minimise wastage, breakage, and unnecessary consumption.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of restaurant equipment and supplies.
* Coordinate with the Store and Kitchen teams regarding stock requirements.
* Report stock discrepancies, wastage, breakages, and operational losses to the Restaurant Manager.

6\. POS, Billing \& Cash Handling

* Ensure accurate billing and POS operations.
* Monitor payments and transactions during the shift.
* Ensure discounts, complimentary items, voids, and refunds are processed strictly as per company policy.
* Assist with shift closing and cash\-handling procedures where applicable.
* Immediately report billing or cash discrepancies.

7\. Hygiene, Safety \& Compliance

* Ensure high standards of personal hygiene, grooming, and restaurant cleanliness.
* Monitor compliance with food safety and hygiene standards.
* Conduct regular checks of dining, service, and guest areas.
* Ensure safety procedures are followed by the team.
* Report maintenance, equipment, or safety issues promptly.

8\. Reporting \& Coordination

* Maintain shift reports and operational records.
* Communicate daily operational issues and important observations to the Restaurant Manager.
* Coordinate with HR regarding attendance, staffing, employee concerns, and disciplinary matters.
* Coordinate with Accounts, Procurement, Kitchen, Bakery, Store, and other departments as required.
* Assist in operational audits and implementation of corrective actions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Sales target achievement
* Guest satisfaction and feedback
* Service quality and efficiency
* Team productivity
* Staff attendance and punctuality
* Upselling performance
* Inventory control and wastage
* SOP compliance
* Hygiene and cleanliness standards
* Guest complaint resolution
* Team discipline and grooming
* Overall outlet operational performance

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor's/Diploma in Hotel Management, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
* **3–5 years of relevant experience in F\&B / restaurant operations.**
* Previous experience in a supervisory or team\-leadership role.
* Strong understanding of restaurant operations and service standards.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong guest\-service orientation.
* Good leadership and people\-management skills.
* Ability to handle pressure and manage multiple operational priorities.
* Working knowledge of POS systems and basic reporting.
* Basic understanding of sales, inventory, and cost control.
* Willingness to work in shifts, weekends, and holidays as per business requirements.

Preferred Experience

* **Fine\-dining or premium hospitality experience will be an added advantage.**
* Experience in premium restaurants, boutique cafés, luxury hotels, or high\-end F\&B establishments will be preferred.
* Exposure to fine\-dining service standards, table service, guest relations, premium hospitality, and beverage service will be an advantage.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a **proactive, and service\-oriented hospitality professional** who enjoys working on the floor and leading by example.

The ideal candidate should be confident in handling guests and teams, have strong attention to detail, and be committed to maintaining AMA Café's standards of **hospitality, service, grooming, hygiene, and overall guest experience**.

description:
**About Medhavi Skills University**
Medhavi Skills University (MSU) is a government\-notified private State Skills University established under a State Act in Sikkim in 2021, dedicated to advancing quality skill\-integrated higher education and entrepreneurship. Recognised by the UGC and aligned with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, MSU is a pioneer in converging the skilling ecosystem with formal higher education through its “Industry as Campus” model. The University collaborates extensively with industries and Skill Development Institutes to deliver work\-integrated degree programs embedding structured on\-the\-job training within the curriculum. MSU is a recognised Awarding Body under NCVET, empanelled with DGT, and serves as an anchor university partner with NSDC and the PMU of NSDC International\-collectively reinforcing its demand\-driven, industry\-co\-led academic framework. Ranked 4th among India’s Top Skill Universities in the Outlook ICARE Rankings 2025 and supported by over 11 defence partnerships along with multiple national recognitions, MSU stands among India’s leading skill\-integrated higher education institutions.  

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in **About Medhavi Group:**
Established in 2013, Medhavi Group is a unified ecosystem comprising MSU and various skill\-promoting organisations, dedicated to advancing skill development, vocational training, and industry\-integrated higher education. With a strong outcome\-driven approach, the Group has trained over 6 lakh learners, achieving more than 70% employability outcomes, and currently supports 20,000\+ active students across its diverse programs. Medhavi Group continues to bridge the gap between education and employment by building scalable, industry\-aligned talent pathways across India. Work Integrated Skill based Higher Education (WISE) is Medhavi’s flagship industry\-integrated initiative built on the principle of “Industry as Campus.” It combines academic learning with structured on\-the\-job training, ensuring students graduate with real work experience and industry\-ready skills. Through deep, outcome\-driven partnerships with over 300\+ leading industry and skill partners across 26\+ sectors including Hyundai, Mahindra, IHG Group, Nephroplus, Barbeque Nation, Nexus Select Malls, ClassPlus, Tata Electronics, Marriott, ITC, and others\- WISE enables learners to acquire role\- specific competencies directly within live business environments. WISE creates a demand\-driven talent pipeline for industries that enhances employability, improves workforce productivity, and bridges the industry skill gap.  

For more information, visit https://msu.edu.in/wise **Role Overview:**

title: Procurement Manager
description:
Procurement Manager – Industrial Automation

**Company:** Graven Automation Private Limited  
**Location:** Delhi NCR  
**Department:** Procurement  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Experience:** 4–8 years  
**Salary:** ₹30,000–₹40,000/month \+ performance incentives *(depending on experience and capability)*

About Graven Automation

Graven Automation is a B2B industrial automation company dealing in PLCs, VFDs, HMIs, servo systems, control components, industrial electronics and automation spares from brands such as Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Allen\-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Delta, Yaskawa and others.

We are building a high\-speed, technology\-driven procurement operation where **ownership, response time and commercial intelligence** matter more than hierarchy.

Role Overview

We are looking for a **Procurement Manager** who can independently manage and improve the complete procurement function.

The person will be responsible for converting sales requirements into commercially viable purchase decisions by identifying suppliers, obtaining competitive pricing, negotiating, checking availability, managing purchase orders and coordinating timely dispatch.

**This is an ownership role — not just an RFQ\-follow\-up role.**

The ideal candidate should be able to look at a requirement and say:

“I have checked the options, these are the available sources, this is the landed cost, this is the expected delivery, and this is my recommendation.”Key Responsibilities1\. Procurement Management

* Manage complete procurement of industrial automation products and spares.
* Handle Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Allen\-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Delta, Yaskawa and other automation brands.
* Source products from authorized distributors, stockists, traders, importers and international suppliers.
* Maintain a strong supplier network across India and overseas.
* Identify alternative suppliers when regular sources cannot fulfil requirements.

2\. Price Negotiation

* Negotiate purchase prices, payment terms, delivery timelines and freight.
* Compare multiple supplier quotations before making purchasing decisions.
* Continuously identify cost\-saving opportunities.
* Maintain historical purchase\-price data and use it during negotiations.
* Understand market pricing and identify abnormal supplier quotations.

3\. Availability \& Lead Time

* Verify actual stock availability instead of relying only on verbal commitments.
* Confirm manufacturing/production dates, condition, warranty and delivery timelines where applicable.
* Track critical and urgent requirements.
* Develop alternate sourcing strategies for obsolete, discontinued or difficult\-to\-source products.

4\. Purchase Orders

* Review procurement requirements received from Sales/CCT.
* Select the appropriate supplier based on price, availability, reliability and delivery.
* Approve/recommend purchases according to company authority limits.
* Ensure purchase orders are accurate and commercially complete.
* Coordinate with Accounts and Dispatch for payment and delivery.

5\. Supplier Management

* Develop and maintain supplier relationships.
* Evaluate suppliers based on price, quality, availability, response time and reliability.
* Onboard new suppliers.
* Maintain supplier performance records.
* Negotiate improved commercial terms with high\-volume suppliers.
* Build backup suppliers for critical products and brands.

6\. Team Management

* Lead and manage the procurement team.
* Allocate procurement requirements among executives.
* Monitor procurement TAT and pending requirements.
* Train team members on sourcing, negotiation and supplier evaluation.
* Review team performance daily/weekly.
* Ensure no procurement requirement remains without an owner or next action.

7\. Cross\-Department Coordination

Work closely with:

**Sales → CCT → Procurement → Accounts → Dispatch**

Ensure that procurement does not become a bottleneck for sales orders.

8\. CRM / GravenOneDesk

* Maintain 100% procurement activity in GravenOneDesk.
* Ensure every requirement has a clear owner, status, next action and expected completion time.
* Maintain supplier quotations, purchase prices and procurement history.
* Monitor ageing and SLA breaches.
* Use procurement data to identify pricing trends, suppliers and savings opportunities.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)KPIWeightProcurement TAT25%Purchase Price / Cost Savings20%Product Availability \& Lead Time15%Supplier Response \& Reliability10%New Supplier Development10%PO Accuracy10%Dispatch Coordination5%CRM Discipline5%Expected Performance

* Standard procurement requirement: **initial response within 30 minutes**
* Standard sourcing: **target completion within 2 hours**
* Urgent requirements: **priority handling immediately**
* Zero unattended procurement requirements.
* Every pending requirement must have a documented reason and next action.
* Escalation should happen **with a recommendation**, not simply with the problem.

What We Are Looking ForMust Have

* 4–8 years of procurement/purchasing experience.
* Experience with industrial automation/electrical/electronics/MRO products.
* Strong vendor network and sourcing capability.
* Excellent negotiation skills.
* Good understanding of PLC, VFD, HMI, servo, control components and industrial electrical products.
* Strong Excel/ERP/CRM skills.
* Ability to work under strict TATs.
* Strong communication and commercial judgement.

Preferred

* Experience with Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Allen\-Bradley, Mitsubishi, Delta, Yaskawa or similar brands.
* Experience in import/domestic sourcing.
* Experience dealing with distributors, stockists and system integrators.
* Experience managing a procurement team.
* Experience in B2B industrial distribution.

Most Important: Ownership

We are **not looking for someone who waits for instructions for every decision.**

We want someone who:

* Finds solutions before escalating.
* Negotiates instead of simply forwarding supplier prices.
* Finds alternate suppliers when the first supplier fails.
* Takes responsibility for delivery commitments.
* Tracks pending requirements without being reminded.
* Makes recommendations backed by data.
* Accepts mistakes and fixes them quickly.
* Understands that **procurement directly affects sales, margin and customer satisfaction.**

Our principle:

**Escalate the problem. Never escalate the ownership.**

Why Join Graven Automation?

* Fast\-growing industrial automation business.
* Technology\-driven procurement environment.
* GravenOneDesk CRM/ERP for real\-time operations.
* Opportunity to build and lead a professional procurement function.
* Performance\-based growth and incentives.
* Direct exposure to high\-value B2B industrial transactions.
* Opportunity to grow into **Head of Procurement / Procurement Operations Head** based on performance.

Selection Process

**Round 1:** HR / Initial Screening  
**Round 2:** Procurement \& Technical Assessment  
**Round 3:** Commercial Negotiation Case Study  
**Round 4:** Management Interview

Candidates will be evaluated on:

**Knowledge \+ Negotiation \+ Speed \+ Problem Solving \+ Ownership**

Only candidates who demonstrate the ability to **independently own procurement outcomes** will be selected.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

description:
**Company Description**  

The Senior Manager – GA is the cornerstone of close excellence and balance sheet integrity within their scope. The role ensures that every financial result is accurate, audit\-ready, and delivered with confidence—while building a capable, accountable, and continuously improving team.  

  

Role Purpose  

  

The Senior Manager – General Accounting is responsible for delivering accurate, compliant, and timely financial results for an assigned cluster of entities. The role ensures disciplined month\-end close execution, robust balance sheet governance, SOX\-compliant controls, and strong partnership with Controllers. This leader drives performance, uplifts process maturity, and develops a high\-performing accounting team that demonstrates accountability, transparency, and operational excellence.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

1\. Close Execution and Financial Accuracy  

* Own month\-end and quarter\-end close activities for assigned entities, ensuring First\-Time\-Right (FTR) outcomes.
* Review Trial Balance, validate account movements, and ensure accuracy of journals, accruals, and provisions.
* Ensure full adherence to close calendar, cut\-offs, and controller expectations, maintaining a zero\-surprise environment.
* Drive governance routines, including pre\-close reviews, WD discipline, and quality checkpoints.


2\. Balance Sheet Governance and Risk Management  

  

* Ensure 100% balance sheet reconciliation completeness, accuracy, and timely approvals.
* Identify aged items, risks, and exposures early, driving remediation through root\-cause elimination.
* Ensure documentation integrity and audit\-ready reconciliations aligned with global policy.


3\. Controls and Compliance  

  

* Enforce SOX controls, journal approval discipline, evidence standards, and documentation requirements.
* Ensure teams are audit\-ready at all times, supporting internal/external audits with transparency and zero repeat findings.
* Maintain compliance with IFRS/US GAAP, NIQ policies, and global control frameworks.


4\. Stakeholder Management  

  

* Act as the operational partner to Entity/Cluster Controllers, Close Managers, and Finance stakeholders.
* Provide clear, data\-driven progress updates, risk visibility, and solution\-oriented communication.
* Manage escalations proactively and professionally, ensuring confidence in financial outcomes.


5\. People Leadership and Capability Development  

  

* Lead a team of Team Leads, Assistant Managers, and Analysts, ensuring clarity of goals, accountability, and performance.
* Drive a performance\-based culture with coaching, documented feedback, and role clarity; address bottom talent proactively.
* Build technical, control, and problem\-solving capabilities within the team; support succession planning and retention.


6\. Continuous Improvement and Standardisation  

  

* Reduce rework, improve accuracy, and eliminate process failures through structured CI initiatives.
* Ensure full adoption of global SOPs, standard work practices, and documentation discipline.
* Contribute to simplification, cycle\-time reduction, and process efficiency enhancements.


7\. Digital, Automation, and Analytics Adoption  

  

* Ensure effective use of ERP, OneStream, dashboards, and governance tools across all BAU processes.
* Support automation and analytics use cases to strengthen controls and improve productivity.

Loss prevention has numerous duties and responsibilities that are crucial for preventing the company from losing money and merchandise, while also ensuring a safe shopping experience.

* **The following are major duties and responsibilities of a Loss Prevention Officer:**
* 1\. Monitor for unusual activity at retail stores
* 2\. Monitor security systems, like alarms and closed\-circuit cameras, to ensure they are working properly and in alignment for getting correct Visuals, including internet, router, etc
* 3\. Identify potential thieves from customers or staff.
* 4\. Follow and confront a potential person of interest who is suspected of shoplifting.
* 5\. Document theft and other violations of security, and what they observed on duty.
* 6\. Work with law enforcement to detain suspects of shoplifting or dishonest employees.
* 7\. In retail stores, loss prevention protects people, money, equipment, and merchandise.
* 8\. Undercover store detectives to prevent theft.
* 9\. Count walk\-in customers / Conversion Ratio to sales invoices
* 10\. Record / Picture unusual activities

**Retail Store Operations:**

* 1\. See that retail store staff do not use mobile/s during retail sales hours or at the store
* 2\. Ensure that retail store staff are present at the store on time as per the roster with specified uniform and grooming standards.
* 3\. Count Customer Walk\-ins and generate a conversion ratio to inform the store in charge to increase the conversion ratio regularly
* 4\. Identify and report suspicious activities or policy violations.
* 5\. Coordinate with Store Managers and Area Managers on inventory discrepancies.
* 6\. Investigate incidents and prepare factual reports with preventive action plans.
* 7\. Support training and awareness sessions for store teams on loss prevention.
* 8\. Strong observation, investigation, and reporting skills.
* 9\. Ability to handle confidential information with integrity.
* 10\. Maintain data of the above and inform the HR/reporting manager for penalties, which have to be reported in the concerned group within 24 hours of the incident.

**Inventory:**

* 2\. Mandatory to implement a monthly physical audit, identify differences and make reports to cut down variances every month

title: HR Business Partner – Talent Acquisition
description:
HR Business Partner – Talent Acquisition \| 2–4 Years

**About the Company**

A fast\-growing organization in the Real Estate sector, focused on building scalable business operations and strengthening its people practices. As the organization continues to grow, the HR function is looking for a Talent Acquisition professional who can take ownership of end\-to\-end hiring while progressively expanding into broader HR Business Partnering responsibilities.

**The Opportunity**

This role is designed for a Talent Acquisition professional who is ready to take the next step in their HR career.

Talent Acquisition will be the core area of responsibility, with the opportunity to work closely with leadership and business stakeholders on manpower planning, talent pipelines, hiring across functions, and strengthening the recruitment process.

Alongside TA, the role will provide hands\-on exposure to broader HR areas including employee engagement, performance management, employee relations, HR operations, and other people initiatives.

The ideal candidate will be hands\-on, proactive, relationship\-oriented, and comfortable owning the recruitment lifecycle independently while developing the business understanding and stakeholder management capabilities required to grow into an HR Business Partner.

**A Note on Where This Role Is Headed**

This role is intended for an HR professional who wants to build a career beyond Talent Acquisition.

The immediate focus will be on building strong ownership of hiring and talent processes. Over time, the role will expand into broader HR Business Partnering, with increasing involvement in employee lifecycle, people processes, manager support, and business\-facing HR initiatives.

As the organization grows, there will be opportunities to take ownership of larger hiring mandates, work more closely with leadership, and contribute to building a scalable HR function.

Key Responsibilities1\. Talent Acquisition \& Hiring — Core Responsibility

* Partner with leadership and hiring managers to understand manpower requirements and translate them into effective hiring plans.
* Own the **end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle**, from sourcing through onboarding.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines across business and support functions.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, agencies, and other relevant channels.
* Screen and assess candidates against role requirements and organizational fit.
* Coordinate interviews and ensure clear communication with candidates and hiring managers throughout the process.
* Manage offer rollouts, negotiations, candidate engagement, and offer\-to\-join conversions.
* Track recruitment progress and proactively address hiring bottlenecks.
* Ensure a positive and consistent candidate experience throughout the hiring journey.
* Maintain recruitment MIS and provide regular updates on hiring metrics, priorities, and progress.
* Support employer branding and initiatives that strengthen the organization's talent pipeline.
* Ensure a smooth joining, onboarding, and induction experience for new hires.

**Key Metrics:** Hiring turnaround time, quality of hire, offer\-to\-join ratio, hiring manager satisfaction, and candidate experience.

2\. HR Business Partnering \& Stakeholder Management

* Act as an HR point of contact for employees and business teams.
* Build strong working relationships with managers and business stakeholders.
* Understand people\-related requirements and provide timely HR support.
* Support managers on employee\-related matters and people decisions.
* Support the implementation of HR processes, policies, and initiatives across the organization.
* Develop a strong understanding of business priorities and their people implications.

3\. Employee Engagement, Performance \& Development

* Support performance management processes, including goal setting, reviews, and continuous feedback.
* Coordinate employee engagement and recognition initiatives.
* Identify learning and development requirements and coordinate relevant interventions.
* Contribute to initiatives that strengthen employee experience and workplace culture.

4\. Employee Relations \& HR Operations

* Support employee relations, grievance handling, and employee communication with maturity and confidentiality.
* Coordinate employee exits, exit interviews, and full and final settlement processes.
* Support payroll inputs, attendance management, employee documentation, and HR administration.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases.
* Track HR metrics and provide relevant insights to leadership.
* Support statutory compliance and ensure required documentation is maintained.

What We’re Looking For

* **2–4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Human Resources**, with strong hands\-on recruitment experience.
* Proven experience managing **end\-to\-end hiring independently** across multiple functions and levels.
* Strong sourcing, screening, stakeholder management, interview coordination, and offer negotiation skills.
* Experience in **Real Estate / Construction** is preferred.
* Ability to build and maintain strong candidate pipelines.
* Strong understanding of recruitment metrics and hiring processes.

* Reduce attrition and maintain team stability

**Success Metrics**

* Attrition rate ↓
* Retention of key employees
* Employee satisfaction (informal feedback)

**6\. Cost Efficiency**

* Manage hiring and HR costs effectively

**Success Metrics**

* Cost per hire
* Minimal dependency on expensive agencies
* Optimized HR processes

**Skills \& Competencies Required**

* Strong hands\-on experience in **recruitment and HR operations**
* Practical knowledge of **HR policies and labour law basics**

* Proficiency in **Excel, Google Sheets, and basic HRMS tools**

**Preferred Profile**

* Strong ownership and problem\-solving attitude

title: Manager Facilities
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Technical Facilities Management**

* Manage day\-to\-day technical facilities operations for the Pune office and coordinate technical facility requirements for Hyderabad.
* Ensure smooth functioning and preventive maintenance of:
	+ Electrical systems and DG/UPS systems
	+ HVAC and air\-conditioning systems
	+ Fire detection and firefighting systems
	+ Access control and CCTV systems
	+ Plumbing and water supply systems
	+ Elevators/lifts
	+ Building management systems, where applicable
	+ Power backup and other critical infrastructure
* Develop and monitor preventive and corrective maintenance schedules.
* Coordinate with building management, landlords, AMC partners and specialist technical vendors.
* Ensure timely resolution of breakdowns and minimize workplace downtime.
* Monitor energy consumption and identify opportunities for energy efficiency and cost optimization.
* Maintain records of equipment, maintenance schedules, warranties, AMCs and service reports.

**2\. Soft Facilities Management**

* Manage overall workplace services and employee\-facing facilities.
* Oversee housekeeping, pantry/cafeteria services, office supplies, reception/front\-office support, pest control, waste management and other facility services.
* Ensure high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, workplace presentation and employee experience.
* Manage seating, space utilization, meeting rooms and workplace infrastructure requirements.
* Coordinate office moves, seating changes, events and other workplace\-related requirements.
* Establish and monitor service standards and SLAs for all facility service providers.
* Conduct regular facility inspections and take corrective actions where required.

**3\. Employee Transportation – Pune \& Hyderabad**

* Own and coordinate employee transportation operations for the Pune office, including day\-to\-day transport requirements for employees working in different shifts.
* Provide coordination and operational oversight for employee transportation for Hyderabad night\-shift employees.
* Ensure safe, reliable and timely transportation for employees, particularly during night shifts.
* Coordinate with transportation vendors, transport desk/teams, security and internal stakeholders.
* Manage cab routes, rosters, vehicle allocation, trip schedules and shift requirements.
* Monitor transportation vendor performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs.
* Ensure compliance with applicable employee transportation, safety and security requirements.
* Monitor trip\-related incidents, delays, complaints and escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Review transportation costs and identify opportunities for route optimization and cost efficiency.
* Ensure appropriate escalation and contingency arrangements are available for late\-night or emergency situations.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure that transportation arrangements remain aligned with employee shift patterns and business requirements.

**4\. Night\-Shift Facilities Coordination**

* Coordinate and oversee facilities requirements for **night\-shift operations in both Pune and Hyderabad** .
* Ensure appropriate availability of security, housekeeping, transportation, pantry and other essential facility services during night shifts.
* Establish clear escalation mechanisms for facility or employee transportation issues occurring outside normal business hours.
* Coordinate remotely with Hyderabad teams/vendors and travel to Hyderabad when required for operational reviews, audits, projects or escalations.
* Ensure adequate support and contingency arrangements for critical night\-shift requirements.

**5\. Vendor \& Contract Management**

* Manage facility and transportation vendors, contractors and service providers.
* Negotiate and manage service contracts, AMCs, SLAs and commercial terms in coordination with procurement and relevant stakeholders.
* Conduct periodic vendor performance reviews.
* Ensure vendor compliance with company policies, statutory requirements and agreed service standards.
* Validate service delivery, invoices and supporting documentation before processing.
* Drive continuous improvement and cost optimization across facility and transportation contracts.

**6\. Health, Safety, Security \& Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, safety, fire, environmental and workplace requirements.
* Coordinate fire and emergency preparedness activities, drills and evacuation procedures.
* Maintain required facility\-related licenses, certificates, inspection reports and statutory records.
* Work closely with the Security team to ensure effective access control, visitor management and workplace security.
* Identify workplace hazards and implement appropriate corrective and preventive measures.
* Ensure contractors and vendors follow required safety protocols.
* Support business continuity and emergency response plans for facility\-related incidents.

**7\. Budget \& Cost Management**

* Prepare and manage the annual facilities and transportation budget.
* Monitor monthly expenditure against approved budgets.
* Identify cost\-saving and process\-improvement opportunities without compromising employee experience or safety.
* Track utility, maintenance, housekeeping, transportation and other facility\-related costs.
* Support procurement activities, vendor negotiations and renewal of service contracts.

**8\. Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary point of contact for workplace and facility\-related matters for the Pune office.
* Coordinate with Hyderabad stakeholders for facilities and transportation requirements.
* Work closely with HR, Administration, IT, Security, Finance, Procurement, Business/Operations teams and building management.
* Understand business requirements and translate them into effective workplace and facility solutions.
* Manage employee concerns and escalations related to facilities and transportation.
* Provide regular MIS, dashboards and management reports on facilities, vendors, transportation, costs, incidents and service levels.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Facility uptime and timely resolution of breakdowns
* Preventive maintenance compliance
* Employee satisfaction with workplace services
* Housekeeping and workplace hygiene standards
* Transportation on\-time performance
* Transportation safety and incident management
* Vendor SLA compliance
* Facilities and transportation budget adherence
* Cost optimization and savings
* Statutory and safety compliance
* Closure of employee complaints/escalations within agreed timelines
* Effective support for night\-shift operations in Pune and Hyderabad

**Candidate Profile**

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Administration, Operations, Hospitality or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional certifications in facilities management, safety or engineering will be an advantage.

**Experience:**

* Typically **8–12 years of relevant experience** in facilities/workplace management/employee transportation preferably in a corporate office, technology, BPO/ITES, shared services or similar environment.
* Strong experience in both **technical and soft facilities management** .
* Prior experience managing **employee transportation and night\-shift operations** is highly desirable.
* Experience managing multi\-location facilities will be an advantage.
* Experience in vendor management, budgeting, compliance and service\-level management is essential.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of technical and soft facilities management
* Good understanding of electrical, HVAC, fire \& safety and building infrastructure
* Employee transportation and shift\-management experience
* Strong vendor and contract management skills
* Excellent problem\-solving and escalation\-management capabilities
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
* Strong commercial and cost\-management orientation
* Good analytical and reporting skills
* Ability to manage emergencies and operational issues calmly and effectively
* Willingness to support/coordinate **night\-shift operations when required**
* Willingness to travel between **Pune and Hyderabad** as business requirements dictate

**Role Expectations**

This is a **hands\-on facilities leadership role** requiring the individual to take ownership of workplace operations rather than only coordinate administrative activities. The incumbent should be comfortable managing vendors and internal stakeholders, responding to operational escalations, supporting employees working in shifts, and ensuring that both Pune and Hyderabad operations receive the required facilities and transportation support.


The individual will be **based in Pune** , with primary ownership of Pune facilities and transportation, while providing coordination and oversight for Hyderabad requirements, particularly for **night\-shift employees and associated facilities/transportation operations** .

title: Associate – Business Finance & Accounts
description:
**Associate – Business Finance \& Accounts**

Job Description

Company: Abhinaya Cinemas

Department: Business Finance \& Accounts

Location: Head Office, Changanacherry, Kerala

Reports to: Finance Manager

Employment Type: Full\-time, on\-site

Compensation: ₹20,000 – ₹28,000 per month, based on qualification, skills and assessment

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

Abhinaya Cinemas is looking for an Associate – Business Finance \& Accounts to join our head office finance team.

This is an entry\-level role built for someone at the start of their career who wants to learn how money actually

moves through a business — daily box office collections, food \& beverage sales, vendor payments, distributor

settlements, payroll and statutory filings — across a multi\-location cinema operation with a multi\-decade legacy.

The role is deliberately designed for a candidate who is as comfortable with software as with a ledger. A large part

of our finance work is being rebuilt around automation: dashboards instead of manual MIS, system\-to\-system data

flows instead of re\-keying, and validated templates instead of ad\-hoc spreadsheets. We want an Associate who will

not simply run the process as it exists, but will look at a recurring task and ask whether it needs to be done by hand at all.

You will be trained on the accounting fundamentals. What you bring is accuracy, curiosity, and an instinct for using technology to do the job better.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Daily Accounting \& Bookkeeping

* Record day\-to\-day transactions in the accounting system — sales, purchases, expenses, journal entries and bank transactions.
* Maintain accurate ledgers, vouchers and supporting documentation, filed and retrievable.
* Process vendor bills and payments, track advances, and maintain the payables schedule.
* Handle petty cash accounting and expense claims across cinema locations.

Revenue \& Reconciliation

* Reconcile daily box office collections against the ticketing system, online aggregator reports and bank credits.
* Reconcile food \& beverage / Cafe Abhinaya POS sales, stock movement and cash–card–UPI settlements.
* Perform bank reconciliations and follow up on unmatched or delayed settlements.
* Support distributor and film\-hire settlement workings and share calculations.

Statutory \& Compliance Support

* Prepare working files for GST returns, TDS and other statutory filings; assist with timely submission.
* Support monthly payroll inputs in coordination with HR — attendance, deductions, PF and ESI schedules.
* Assist with audits by preparing schedules, ledger extracts and supporting documents.
* Maintain compliance calendars and flag due dates before they arrive.

Automation \& Systems Improvement

* Build and maintain Excel / Google Sheets models with formulas, validation and pivot\-based reporting that replace manual re\-keying.
* **Identify repetitive finance tasks and propose ways to automate or simplify them.**
* Help migrate and clean data as we move processes onto better tools; test new workflows and document them.
* **Write and maintain simple SOPs so that every recurring process is repeatable by anyone in the team.**
* Reporting \& Analysis
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS — collections, occupancy\-linked revenue, F\&B performance, expense
* summaries.
* **Assist with budget versus actual tracking and highlight variances with a plain\-English explanation.**
* Support the Finance Manager with ad\-hoc analysis for management decisions.
* QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE
* **B.Com, M.Com, or MBA (Finance), CA Inter — freshers are welcome and encouraged to apply.**
* 1\-5 years of experience; internships, articleship exposure or academic projects in accounting count.
* **Sound understanding of accounting fundamentals — double entry, ledgers, trial balance, and basic financial**
* statements.
* Awareness of GST and TDS basics; willingness to learn statutory compliance on the job.
* **Strong command of Excel or Google Sheets (formulas, lookups, pivot tables); comfort with Tally or any**
* accounting software is an advantage.

**SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES**

* Technically fluent. Picks up new software quickly and prefers a system to a sticky note. Familiarity with
* automation tools — advanced spreadsheet functions, Google Apps Script, Power Query, Zoho / Tally
* integrations, or AI tools — is a strong plus.
* **Accurate. Treats a mismatched rupee as a problem to be solved, not rounded away.**
* Forward thinking. Asks “why is this done this way?” and comes back with a better way.
* **Organised. Manages deadlines, filings and month\-end without needing to be chased.**
* Discreet. Handles financial and payroll information with confidentiality.
* **Communicative. Explains numbers clearly to people who are not accountants; working proficiency in English**
* and Malayalam.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Ground\-floor exposure to the complete finance cycle of a running business — not a single narrow task repeated
* for a year.
* **Direct mentoring from the Finance Manager, with real ownership from early on.**
* A genuine mandate to modernise how our accounting is done, and the freedom to propose and build those
* improvements.
* A stable, established Kerala cinema brand with an active growth pipeline.
* Clear progression to Senior Associate for candidates who deliver.

To apply, please share your updated CV with the HR team. Abhinaya Cinemas is an equal opportunity employer.

description:
### **About EarnIn**



As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real\-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.



We're fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world\-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We're growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world\-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.


**POSITION SUMMARY**



Join EarnIn's Analytics Engineering team for a 6\-month internship building the data foundation that powers business decisions, and the AI systems that make that data accessible to every analyst at EarnIn. You'll own meaningful end\-to\-end work across two connected workstreams \- data modeling and AI\-powered analytics\- under the guidance of senior analytics engineers. This position is based in Bengaluru, India, with two days a week in\-office required as part of our expanding site location, and is a 6\-month contract engagement with a start date in January 2027\.

* Contribute to the Agentic Analytics system, an AI agent that answers business questions by generating and evaluating SQL, by reviewing agent outputs for correctness, curating golden evaluation datasets, and capturing domain business rules that improve the agent's accuracy over time.

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree (B.E., B.Tech., M.Tech., or equivalent) in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from an Indian university

title: Hospital Receptionist
description:
**Department:** Front Office / Reception  
**Designation:** Hospital Receptionist  
**Reporting To:** Manager \- Operations

**1\. Job Purpose**

To provide a professional, courteous, and welcoming first point of contact for patients, attendants, visitors, and hospital stakeholders. The Hospital Receptionist is responsible for managing front\-desk operations, assisting patients with enquiries, coordinating with relevant departments, and ensuring a smooth and positive patient experience.

**2\. Key Responsibilities**

* Welcome and greet patients, attendants, visitors, and doctors in a **professional and courteous manner**.
* Maintain a **well\-groomed, professional appearance** and follow hospital grooming and uniform standards at all times.
* Communicate clearly and politely with patients and visitors.
* Attend incoming telephone calls and direct calls to the appropriate department or staff member.
* Provide accurate information regarding hospital services, departments, consultation timings, and general enquiries.
* Assist patients with registration, appointment scheduling, and billing\-related directions.
* Guide patients and attendants to the appropriate departments, consultation rooms, diagnostic areas, pharmacy, billing counters, etc.
* Coordinate with OPD, Nursing, Billing, Insurance, Laboratory, Radiology, and other departments as required.
* Handle patient and visitor enquiries professionally and escalate complaints or concerns to the concerned authority.
* Maintain proper records, registers, visitor details, appointment information, and other front\-office documentation.
* Assist elderly patients, persons requiring special assistance, and patients who need guidance within the hospital.
* Ensure the reception/front\-office area remains **clean, organized, and presentable**.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient and hospital information.
* Follow hospital policies, SOPs, safety procedures, and service standards.
* Support emergency situations by promptly informing the appropriate department/personnel.
* Maintain professional conduct and avoid unnecessary personal conversations or gatherings at the reception area.
* Perform any other duties assigned by the Front Office In\-charge / Administration.

**3\. Required Skills \& Competencies**

* **Excellent communication skills** – verbal and written.
* Good interpersonal and customer\-service skills.
* Pleasant, polite, and professional attitude.
* **Good grooming and professional presentation.**
* Ability to communicate effectively with patients, attendants, doctors, and hospital staff.
* Basic computer knowledge and familiarity with MS Office / hospital software.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work under pressure.
* Good telephone etiquette.
* Strong listening and problem\-solving skills.
* Patience and empathy when dealing with patients and attendants.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional boundaries.
* Good teamwork and coordination skills.
* Ability to work in shifts, including weekends and holidays as per hospital requirements.

**4\. Educational Qualification**

* Minimum Graduate preferred.
* Diploma / Certificate in Hospital Administration, Front Office Management, or a related field will be an added advantage.

**5\. Experience**

* **1–3 years of experience** in hospital reception, front office, customer service, healthcare, hotel, or a similar service\-oriented environment.
* Freshers with excellent communication skills and a professional attitude may also be considered.

**6\. Professional Standards**

The Receptionist is expected to:

* Report to duty on time and maintain punctuality.
* Maintain proper uniform, personal hygiene, and grooming standards.
* Wear the prescribed ID card at all times while on duty.
* Maintain a calm, respectful, and patient\-friendly approach.
* Avoid arguments or inappropriate communication with patients, attendants, or colleagues.
* Maintain discipline and professional behavior at the reception area.
* Ensure patient information and hospital matters are kept strictly confidential.

**7\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Patient and visitor satisfaction.
* Professional appearance and grooming.
* Communication and telephone etiquette.
* Accuracy of registration and front\-office documentation.
* Timely response to patient enquiries.
* Coordination with departments.
* Attendance and punctuality.
* Compliance with hospital policies and SOPs.
* Maintenance of a clean and organized reception area.
* Complaint handling and escalation.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
**Company:** FerrySwiss  
**Position:** Creative Content Creator – Video \& Social Media  
**Type:** Full\-Time / Internship

About the Role

We are looking for a **creative, skilled, and proactive Creative Content Creator** to join our team. The selected candidate will be responsible for creating high\-quality visual content, including **videos, Reels, images, posters, product videos, and other social media content**.

A key requirement for this role is the ability to **independently shoot and edit professional\-quality videos**. The candidate should have relevant education, training, certification, or practical experience in videography, video editing, media production, photography, or a related field.

The role also involves planning and coordinating content shoots, including identifying suitable **actors/models, locations, concepts, props, products, and other requirements**.

Our products and brands may include **Relaxowave.com, Marshalway.com, FerrySwiss.com, and Storesdeals.com**.

Key Responsibilities

* **Independently shoot and edit videos** for social media and marketing.
* Create engaging **Reels, Shorts, promotional videos, product videos, and lifestyle content**.
* Handle the complete content creation process from **concept and planning to shooting, editing, and final delivery**.
* Create attractive **images, posters, graphics, and other social media content**.
* Develop creative concepts and ideas for videos and social media campaigns.
* Research and identify suitable **actors, models, influencers, and other participants** for shoots.
* Find and suggest suitable **shooting locations** based on the content requirements.
* Plan and coordinate video and photo shoots.
* Identify and arrange necessary **props, products, equipment, and other shoot requirements**.
* Research current **social media trends, trending Reels, music, formats, and creative ideas**.
* Work with the team to understand products and create suitable visual content for marketing.

Mandatory Requirements

* **Must be able to independently shoot and edit videos.**
* Practical knowledge of **videography, camera handling, lighting, framing, and video editing**.
* Relevant degree, diploma, certification, training, or practical experience in **Videography, Video Editing, Media Production, Photography, Film, Digital Media, or a related field**.
* Comfortable creating content for **Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short\-form platforms**.
* Ability to use **professional cameras or smartphones** to produce high\-quality video content.
* A **portfolio, sample videos, Reels, or previous work** will be an advantage.

Additional Skills Preferred

* Graphic design and poster creation.
* Photography and photo editing.
* Familiarity with **Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Canva, Photoshop**, or similar tools.
* Creative thinking and the ability to develop new content ideas.
* Good research, planning, coordination, and communication skills.
* Ability to independently identify **actors, locations, props, and other resources** required for content shoots.

Who Can Apply?

We welcome applications from **experienced professionals, freshers, students, and interns** with relevant skills or experience in **videography, video editing, photography, media production, graphic design, or social media content creation**.

Previous full\-time experience is **not mandatory**. Candidates can demonstrate their skills through **professional experience, internships, freelance work, college projects, personal projects, or self\-learning**.

The key requirement is the ability to **independently shoot and edit high\-quality videos** and create engaging social media content.

This role provides hands\-on experience in the complete content creation process, including **concept development, shoot planning, finding actors and locations, filming, editing, and creating content for multiple brands and products**.

Pay: ₹5,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Work from home

**HR Talent Acquisition Intern**
================================

**The Basics**
--------------

**Team:** Human Resources  

**Experience:** Freshers / 1–2 HR internships  

**Location:** Mumbai – Andheri East

**Introduction**
================


$11 trillion of money flows every year between companies in India. It typically takes an average of 70 days for a business to get paid, and it's increasing by 5% every year. Formal funding options are limited and cover less than 5% of the addressable market.


We are building India's largest B2B Payments Platform that transforms how businesses pay and get paid. The platform already processes INR 20,000\+ Crores of invoices every month across 300,000 MSMEs and 1200\+ corporates, with 30\+ lenders plugged in for credit. Globally, companies in this space like Coupa, Bill.com, Melio, C2FO, and Tipalti have witnessed tremendous success over the past decade, doing $ Billion\+ disbursements weekly and cumulatively valued at over $50 Billion.


You will join our core team that currently consists of ex\-BCG and ISB/IIM alumni, with a team of industry veterans serving on the advisory board. We are backed by Elevation Capital (one of the most successful VCs in India) and General Catalyst ($15 Billion\+ global fund and early investors in Stripe, Airbnb, etc.). We share our lineage with HCS, a 25\-year\-old investment bank and registered NBFC.


We are a team of passionate problem solvers building a technology company with a strong product innovation mindset.


We are looking for someone who is ambitious, curious, highly organized, and eager to build a career in Human Resources. If you're someone who enjoys interacting with people, thrives in a fast\-paced startup environment, and wants hands\-on exposure to Talent Acquisition and HR Operations, we'd love to hear from you.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
====================================

**1\. Talent Acquisition**
--------------------------

* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, referrals, and other hiring platforms.
* Screen resumes and identify suitable candidates based on role requirements.
* Reach out to prospective candidates and coordinate interview schedules.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process to ensure a great candidate experience.
* Coordinate with hiring managers for interview feedback and interview logistics.
* Maintain and update candidate records in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Assist in preparing offer letters and supporting the offer rollout process.
* Track hiring metrics and maintain recruitment reports.

**2\. HR Operations**
---------------------

* Support employee onboarding by coordinating documentation and pre\-joining formalities.
* Maintain employee records and HR documentation.
* Assist in background verification and document collection.
* Help coordinate employee engagement activities and HR initiatives.
* Support HR policy communication and other administrative HR tasks.
* Coordinate with internal teams for smooth onboarding and employee lifecycle activities.

**Our Ideal Candidate Will Have**
=================================

* Bachelor's degree (or currently pursuing the final year) in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent organizational and coordination abilities.
* A genuine interest in Talent Acquisition and Human Resources.

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. *List at least two comparative wins for this role over another that someone might consider. Example follows.*


**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**
  

Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.


**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**
  

There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.  

  



**Impact In This Role:**


An HR Intern would provide meaningful execution support by working closely on the planning, coordination, documentation, follow\-up, and implementation of key initiatives. Helping in improving the speed and quality of execution while ensuring that important strategic priorities receive adequate attention.


The intent is therefore not to create an additional administrative layer, but to build execution capacity for critical HR initiatives and ensure that planned improvements are translated into tangible outcomes.


This role is for 6 months period of internship.

  

**What You’ll Be Doing:**


The intern will primarily support two categories of work:


**A. One\-Time / Priority Projects**


These initiatives require research, coordination, evaluation, and implementation support.


* Evaluation of Alternatives for Keka


* Replacement of BGV


* Replacement of Food Coupon Vendor


* Upcoming Insurance Renewal


**B. Build \& Evolve – Long\-Term HR Initiatives**


In addition to the immediate projects, the intern will support the development and continuous improvement of foundational HR practices.

* **Performance Management** \- Support the development and implementation of effective performance management practices, including KPI definition, tracking, documentation, and process improvement.

  

**Desired Traits**


* Master’s in Business Administration/ Management in HR discipline.
* Empathy and Active Listening
* Strong Communication
* Discretion and Integrity
* Adaptability
  

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**


We’re actively seeking teammates who:


* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world\-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

### **What's in it for you?**


*List at least two comparative wins for this role over another that someone might consider. Example follows.*


**Opportunity To Unlock Your Creativity**  

Think of all the times you were held back from trying new ideas because you were boxed in by bureaucratic legacy processes or old school tactics. Having a growth mindset is deeply ingrained into our company culture since day 1 so Fictiv is an environment where you have the creative liberty and support of the team to try big bold ideas to achieve our sales and customer goals.


**Opportunity To Grow Your Career**  

There are plenty of jobs out there. The question is whether any of them will help you grow in your career? Will you be challenged by teammates to achieve your potential? Or are they roles that will ask you to do more of what you've already mastered. At Fictiv, you'll be surrounded by supportive teammates who will push you to be your best through their curiosity and passion.

  

**Impact In This Role:**



An HR Intern would provide meaningful execution support by working closely on the planning, coordination, documentation, follow\-up, and implementation of key initiatives. Helping in improving the speed and quality of execution while ensuring that important strategic priorities receive adequate attention.



The intent is therefore not to create an additional administrative layer, but to build execution capacity for critical HR initiatives and ensure that planned improvements are translated into tangible outcomes.



This role is for 6 months period of internship.

  


**What You'll Be Doing:**



The intern will primarily support two categories of work:


**A. One\-Time / Priority Projects**



These initiatives require research, coordination, evaluation, and implementation support.



* Evaluation of Alternatives for Keka


* Replacement of BGV


* Replacement of Food Coupon Vendor


* Upcoming Insurance Renewal



**B. Build \& Evolve – Long\-Term HR Initiatives**



In addition to the immediate projects, the intern will support the development and continuous improvement of foundational HR practices.



* **Culture Alignment with Misumi Americas \-** Support initiatives that strengthen alignment with the culture, values, and expected ways of working.


* **Learning \& Development \-** Support the creation and execution of a structured Learning \& Development program


* **Employee Well\-Being \-** Support initiatives focused on employee engagement, well\-being, and overall employee experience.


* **Career Progression** \- Support the development of structured career progression frameworks and related documentation.


* **Process Mapping** \- Assist in documenting, reviewing, and improving IST operations related SOPs to ensure consistency, clarity, and scalability.


* **Performance Management** \- Support the development and implementation of effective performance management practices, including KPI definition, tracking, documentation, and process improvement.
  


**Desired Traits**


* Master's in Business Administration/ Management in HR discipline.
* Empathy and Active Listening
* Strong Communication
* Discretion and Integrity
* Adaptability

  


**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**


We're actively seeking teammates who:


* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an 'always learning' mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world\-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates


We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Lead Specialist Payroll
description:
**Job Description Summary**
---------------------------


Lead Specialist independently resolves complex payroll exceptions, provides day\-to\-day guidance to Specialists, and supports cross\-coverage across payroll processes. The role drives issue resolution through advanced troubleshooting and contributes to documentation and process improvements.

**Primary Function**
--------------------


Responsible for executing and coordinating assigned payroll activities with 100% accuracy and timeliness. Acts as the first\-level escalation point, coaches L2 Specialists, and partners with SMEs/onshore teams to resolve issues and maintain documentation.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------------

* Process payroll and/or final pay checks accurately and ensure pay is delivered on time, following documented procedures and checklists.
* Work pay run audit reports; research and resolve errors/issues before checks are printed or files are transmitted; escalate exceptions as required.
* Monitor payroll mailboxes and ticket queues; respond to requests/forms within the 24\-hour SLA; document actions clearly and professionally.
* Apply US payroll policies, internal controls, and compliance requirements (confidentiality, approvals, audit trail) during daily execution.
* Support ad\-hoc activities and year\-end deliverables as assigned; adapt to peak volumes and critical timelines.
* Maintain current understanding of payroll calendar updates and process changes; complete required trainings on time.

**Additional responsibilities for this level:**

* Serve as first\-level escalation point for complex cases and aging tickets; coordinate resolution with partner teams as needed.
* Coach and mentor L2 Specialists on process execution, quality, and communication; provide onboarding and training support.
* Contribute to SOPs, checklists, and templates with version control; communicate changes to the team.
* Identify trends from audits and case data; recommend corrective actions and participate in small improvement initiatives.
* Support coverage planning within the sub\-team during peaks, downtime, and year\-end timelines.

### **Tax**

* Support employee tax setup changes and validations per workflow; ensure changes align to source documentation.
* Assist with tax\-related inquiries and ticket triage; resolve routine items and route complex items to SMEs/partners.
* Support year\-end activities such as W\-2 validations, corrections workflows, and reprint requests per process.

### **Banking**

* Support direct deposit maintenance and reject/return handling per workflow; ensure corrections are completed within required timelines.
* Assist with payroll funding/file checks and basic reconciliations per checklist; escalate discrepancies promptly.
* Log and track ACH rejects, reversals, and high\-risk exceptions to closure.

### **Garnishment**

* Set up and maintain garnishment/levy deductions based on received orders and established decision trees.
* Process routine agency communications and documentation within SLA; maintain required records.
* Support remittance processing and exception handling per controls; escalate complex scenarios.

### **Processing**

* Execute standard payroll processing steps (data entry, validations, adjustments) according to the payroll calendar.
* Run and review assigned audits; correct basic errors and coordinate dependencies with upstream partners.
* Support off\-cycle processing requests as directed; ensure documentation and approvals are complete.

### **Final Pay**

* Process final pay checks including PTO/other payouts per state requirements and documented guidance; escalate exceptions promptly.
* Support manual check requests, reissues, and reversals; ensure approvals and audit trail are complete.
* Respond to final pay inquiries from HR/field teams using templates and policy references.

**Reporting**
-------------


Reports to: Manager, Payroll Operations.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------


Minimum / Desired Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting/Business/Human Resources (or equivalent experience).
* 2\+ years of payroll operations experience with strong understanding of federal and state payroll requirements.
* Proficient in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; able to analyze reports and identify trends.
* Strong attention to detail; professional communicator able to handle escalations and stakeholder interactions.
* Demonstrated integrity and confidentiality; commitment to coaching and knowledge sharing.
* Flexibility to work extended hours during critical business timelines.
* FPC/CPP is an advantage; Workday/MyTime knowledge is preferred.

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Profile summary:**


Good understanding on monitoring and investment strategies in accordance with Investment guidelines. Keep business informed on regulatory matters like up\-coming regulatory changes etc., Monitoring and reviewing key activities undertaken by the business. Establish as a Trusted Advisor to the business. The source of assessment and interpretation of all risks in the business for NTAM Senior Management and Northern Trust Corporate risk and to be a consultative partner to the front, middle, and back office capabilities, providing transparent information related to the risk of their portfolios, businesses and processes.

 **Job Title: consultant – Investment Risk**

Principal Responsibilities

*Support the Global Investment Risk team across key functional areas:*

* Monitor risk thresholds for portfolios, working closely with risk and portfolio managers to interpret and address any breaches.
* Review and provide oversight on the work produced by analysts and senior analysts.
* Collaborate with the risk management team to design new analytical reporting formats, retire legacy reporting, automate processes, and produce investment risk analysis.
* Develop regularly scheduled exposure analysis and customized risk reports on an ad hoc basis in response to current market conditions.
* Identify opportunities to enhance existing reports and contribute to new projects, initiatives.
* Partner with risk management and senior leadership on matters related to investment risk
* Review and present materials required for Equity and Fixed Income Committee meetings.

**Skills / Experience**

* Internal \- 24 months as Technical Coordinator/Associate Consultant
* Experience of 8\-10 years within investment management industry
* MBA in Finance or equivalent; CFA/FRM or above is an advantage
* Good knowledge of equities, fixed income, alternatives and derivative instruments
* Working knowledge of Power BI, VBA, SQL and Python for is desirable.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build credibility and collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Proven ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment while contributing as a team player across local and global teams.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: HR Counselor
description:
An HR Counselor (often referred to interchangeable with an HR Consultant, HR Advisor, or Employee Relations Specialist) acts as a strategic and empathetic bridge between management and employees. The core focus of this role is to resolve workplace conflicts, gather employee feedback, advise management on HR policies, and foster a productive work environment. Below is a comprehensive and scannable job description template tailored for this position. \-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\-\- \#\# Job Overview We are seeking an empathetic and highly analytical HR Counselor to support our workforce and optimize our internal culture. In this role, you will act as an unbiased confidant for employees, a strategic advisor to management, and a problem\-solver for workplace issues. You will analyze employee feedback, manage conflict resolution, and ensure our HR policies align with both legal compliance and employee satisfaction goals. \[1, 4] \#\# Key Responsibilities Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution \* \* Mediate workplace disputes neutrally between employees or management. \* Counsel employees on career pathing, workplace stress, and interpersonal issues. \* Conduct exit interviews to pinpoint root causes of voluntary turnover. \* Flag systemic issues to leadership to prevent future organizational friction. \[1, 5, 6] \* Feedback \& Data Collection \* \* Administer employee surveys like E\-Sat (Employee Satisfaction) and engagement pulses. \* Capture granular feedback using unbiased, non\-judgmental conversational techniques. \* Analyze people analytics to track trends in workplace morale, retention, and complaints. \[1, 2] \* Policy Advisory \& Compliance \* \* Advise management on creating fair, legal, and modern workplace policies. \* Ensure full compliance with regional and federal labor laws. \* Audit internal processes regularly to catch compliance or cultural vulnerabilities. \[2, 4, 7] \* Training \& Strategy \* \* Coach line managers on how to effectively communicate and support their teams. \* Design training programs covering conflict resolution, diversity, and mental well\-being. \* Collaborate on HR technology implementations to streamline employee feedback loops. \[2, 3, 7] \* \#\# Required Skills \& Qualifications Education \& Experience \* \* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, or Organizational Behaviour. \* Proven experience (typically 2–5\+ years) in HR, employee counseling, or an advisory capacity. \[1, 4, 5] \* Soft Skills \* \* Active listening and the ability to ask deep, probing questions without bias. \* Extreme empathy, patience, tolerance, and emotional intelligence. \* Absolute discretion when handling sensitive, personal, or confidential information. \[1, 5] \* Technical Competencies \* \* Solid understanding of local labor laws and compliance metrics. \*
