title: Senior HR Partner, Amazon International Stores and G&A
description:
**Description**
 At Amazon, HR Partners are known for their deep knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as front\-line talent consultants to the business, supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They offer credible and compelling advice to business managers on how to manage their team. HR Partners collaborate with HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees across the region. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them at scale, in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The Senior HR Partner (Sr. HRP) collaborates with business managers to support them with sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. The Sr. HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Sr. HRPs drive scalable process improvements and standardization at a country, regional as well as global level. The Sr. HRP is expected to work with global HRPs and COE functions to drive WW HRP goals and initiatives.
   

  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases, including process steps, coaching and guidance to deliver fair and high\-bar performance management experience.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR Generalist: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience and change initiatives.


 This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives.
   

  

 Job is open for Bangalore and Hyderabad locations
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master's degree, or Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of HR generalist, management, or business partner role experience
* Knowledge of HR, HR management, organizational development concepts
* Experience in problem solving and delivering results


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in a fast paced, dynamic organization
* Experience managing time efficiently, meeting personal goals, and working effectively with internal, partner, and customer teams
* Experience delivering complex, data\-driven recommendations to senior leaders
* Experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership, or experience managing teams

title: Business Analyst - ERP & Software Implementation
description:
**Business Analyst – ERP \& Software Implementation**

**Company:** ISHAN WORLD  
**Department:** Digital Transformation \& Enterprise Systems  
**Location:** Agra, Uttar Pradesh  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time \| On\-Site  
**Reporting To:** Management / Project Head – Digital Transformation  
**Experience:** Fresher to 4\+ Years (Level based on demonstrated capability)

**About the Role**

**ISHAN WORLD** is looking for a **Business Analyst – ERP \& Software Implementation** who can act as a bridge between Management, business operations, ERP/software systems, developers, testing teams, and end users.

The role involves understanding business requirements, documenting processes, coordinating software and ERP implementation, supporting legacy system transition, conducting testing and UAT, assisting with data migration, preparing training material, and ensuring successful adoption of implemented solutions.

The ideal candidate should be able to:

**Understand → Structure → Document → Coordinate → Configure → Test → Train → Implement → Verify → Close**

Key Responsibilities1\. Business Requirements \& Process Management

* Conduct requirement discussions with Management and business users.
* Understand and document current and future business processes.
* Convert verbal or loosely structured ideas into clear business requirements.
* Identify gaps, contradictions, dependencies, missing decisions, and process improvements.
* Prepare and maintain requirement traceability from discussion to final acceptance.
* Support controlled changes and addendums when new requirements are introduced.

2\. Documentation \& Professional Drafting

* Prepare BRDs, requirement documents, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows.
* Prepare professional emails, meeting notes, action registers, SOPs, user guides, training material, and implementation checklists.
* Maintain configuration, change, issue, testing, UAT, migration, and release documentation.
* Ensure important project knowledge is properly documented and not dependent only on individual employees.

3\. ERPNext / ERP Implementation

* Support ERPNext/Frappe implementation and configuration.
* Assist with Company, Legal Entity, Unit, Branch, Warehouse, User, Role, Workflow, and other master configurations.
* Support Purchase, Inventory, Sales, Finance, and HR\-related ERP configuration and testing.
* Evaluate requirements and identify whether they should be handled through:
* Standard ERP functionality
* Configuration
* Extension
* Integration
* Custom development
* Migration
* Refactoring
* Retention or retirement
* Odoo or other ERP implementation experience will also be considered valuable.

4\. Legacy FoxPro Software Management

* Understand existing FoxPro modules, users, screens, reports, masters, data dependencies, and operational processes.
* Coordinate with the existing FoxPro developer/service provider for bugs, errors, minor updates, and approved changes.
* Maintain a structured issue and change register.
* Evaluate whether issues require an immediate legacy fix, temporary workaround, or migration to the replacement platform.
* Support data extraction, field mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, and migration.
* Test and document corrections before business acceptance.
* Support module\-wise retirement after successful testing, UAT, and data continuity checks.

**FoxPro programming experience is an advantage but is not mandatory.** Functional ownership, structured coordination, and migration discipline are more important.

5\. Software Development Coordination

* Convert approved business requirements into clearly defined development tasks.
* Create requirement references, acceptance conditions, and evidence expectations.
* Coordinate with backend, web/mobile, ERP, and AI\-assisted development resources.
* Track dependencies, blockers, planned timelines, actual progress, and correction cycles.
* Follow tasks through development, review, testing, staging/UAT, and verified closure.
* Escalate unclear requirements, scope expansion, security/financial risks, and recurring issues.

6\. GitHub \& Development Tracking

* Assist in maintaining GitHub Issues, requirement references, Pull Request status, test evidence, correction status, and release notes.
* Understand basic branch and Pull Request workflows.
* Ensure development claims are supported by appropriate code, testing, and review evidence.
* Follow the principle: **“No Evidence \= Not Done.”**
* Understand that coding completion does not automatically mean business acceptance.

7\. Testing \& UAT

* Prepare test scenarios based on approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Perform functional, workflow, permission, negative, exception, integration, web/mobile, and regression testing as applicable.
* Record defects with reproducible steps, screenshots/evidence, expected results, and actual results.
* Retest corrections and maintain closure evidence.
* Support business users during UAT.
* Record approvals, rejections, and pending corrections.
* Verify that software is functionally complete, not merely development\-complete.

8\. Data Migration \& Reconciliation

* Prepare and validate master data such as:
* Products
* Vendors
* Customers
* Employees
* Entities
* Units
* Warehouses
* Tax/HSN data
* Follow a structured migration process:

**Extract → Map → Clean → Deduplicate → Validate → Trial Import → Reconcile → Sign\-Off → Migrate**

* Support migration from FoxPro, existing software, spreadsheets, and other approved sources.
* Identify authoritative data sources and prevent duplication or incorrect overwriting of master and transaction data.

9\. Basic Technical Support

Hands\-on technical capability will be strongly valued. The candidate should ideally have exposure to:

* SQL queries and basic data validation
* REST API testing
* JSON and data mapping
* Basic Python scripting/automation
* ERP configuration and data import utilities
* Git/GitHub
* Basic Linux/Ubuntu commands
* Server/service checks
* Docker/container awareness
* Logs and basic application health checks
* Backup/version/deployment verification
* Basic web/mobile troubleshooting
* Technical communication with developers

This role is **not intended to replace a full\-time Software Developer or DevOps Engineer**, but technical aptitude is highly valued.

10\. Server, Environment \& Deployment Coordination

* Support DEV, Staging/UAT, and Production environment procedures.
* Maintain deployment records including version/commit, deployment evidence, health status, backup status, and rollback references.
* Coordinate with technical/server teams for incidents and planned maintenance.
* Follow approved procedures for production changes and security.
* Maintain confidentiality of credentials and sensitive technical information.

11\. Training \& User Adoption

* Prepare user guides, quick\-reference documents, SOPs, and training content.
* Conduct or support ERP/software demonstrations and user training.
* Assist users during onboarding and first\-level functional troubleshooting.
* Identify recurring user difficulties and convert them into training, UX, or process improvement actions.
* Ensure implemented features are understood and practically usable by business users.

12\. AI\-Assisted Working

* Use approved AI tools such as ChatGPT/Codex and similar tools for:
* Requirement structuring
* Documentation and drafting
* Research
* Test\-case creation
* Data mapping
* Coding assistance
* Troubleshooting
* Validate AI\-generated outputs against approved requirements, actual system behaviour, and authoritative data.
* Understand that AI assists execution but does not replace business approval, code review, testing, security, architecture ownership, or financial controls.

Project Work Allocation

The role will primarily support the following initiatives:

**1\. Ishan World Software \& ERP Transformation – 65–70%**

ERPNext, existing Ishan World platform, requirements, integrations, UAT, migration, rollout, and system control.

**2\. FHICO Software \& Channel Systems – 20–25%**

Distributor/dealer systems, surveys, CRM, mobile/web applications, channel automation, and future system requirements.

**3\. Upcoming Business Software Projects – 10–15%**

Business process discovery, feasibility analysis, process mapping, requirements, prototype support, and implementation as assigned.

*Work allocation may change based on business priorities.*

Qualifications \& Experience

**Preferred Education:**

* BCA / MCA
* B.Tech / B.E. – CS/IT
* B.Sc. – CS/IT
* MBA – IT / Systems / Business Analytics
* BBA / B.Com with strong ERP/software exposure
* Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.

**Experience:**

* Preferred: 1–4 years
* Strong freshers with relevant technical/business understanding may be considered.
* Candidates with 4\+ years of relevant capability may be considered for a senior\-level position.

Relevant Backgrounds

Candidates with experience in any of the following areas are encouraged to apply:

* Business Analysis
* ERP Implementation
* Software Implementation
* Technical Coordination
* QA / UAT
* Data Migration
* Enterprise Applications
* Software Support
* Process Analysis

Skills We Value

* Strong business analysis and requirement gathering
* Excellent documentation and professional drafting
* ERP/software implementation knowledge
* ERPNext/Frappe knowledge is preferred
* Odoo or other ERP experience is valuable
* Functional testing and UAT
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Excel/Google Sheets
* Basic SQL/API knowledge
* Git/GitHub
* Basic Python
* Basic Linux/server understanding
* Strong communication and coordination skills
* Ownership and follow\-through
* Ability to identify and escalate risks
* Willingness to learn new ERP systems, software, and business processes

First 30 / 60 / 90 DaysFirst 30 Days

* Understand Ishan World's business structure and processes.
* Understand current Master/Addendum processes.
* Review active GitHub work and ERPNext direction.
* Understand FoxPro users, modules, and reports.
* Identify key software stakeholders.
* Understand current issue registers, testing standards, and documentation practices.

By 60 Days

* Independently document and track defined business requirements.
* Coordinate routine FoxPro issues.
* Support ERPNext configuration, data, and testing activities.
* Maintain GitHub/UAT evidence.
* Prepare SOPs and training material.

By 90 Days

* Own a meaningful set of business\-system requirements from discussion through verified closure.
* Support legacy\-to\-new\-system migration mapping.
* Provide reliable status and risk reporting.
* Reduce dependency on undocumented or individual\-specific knowledge.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Requirement clarity and traceability
* Documentation completeness and accuracy
* Timely issue/dependency follow\-up and closure
* Quality of testing/UAT evidence
* Defect identification and reporting
* Legacy FoxPro issue resolution and migration readiness
* ERP/software implementation support quality
* Data quality and migration accuracy
* User training and adoption support
* Reduction in repeated manual work
* Reduction in undocumented dependencies
* Early identification and escalation of risks
* Contribution to stable, reproducible, and maintainable software delivery

Working Philosophy

**Understand before configuring.**  
**Reuse before rebuilding.**  
**Configure before customising.**  
**Integrate before duplicating.**  
**Test before releasing.**  
**Document before depending on individuals.**

Career Growth

**Business Analyst – ERP \& Software Implementation**  
↓  
**Senior Business / Systems Analyst**  
↓  
**ERP / Solution Consultant**  
↓  
**Digital Transformation Manager**  
↓  
**Enterprise Systems / Technology Lead**

Why Join This Role?

This position offers an opportunity to work closely with **business operations, ERP transformation, software implementation, legacy\-system transition, testing, data migration, technical coordination, and digital transformation** within Ishan World.

The role is suitable for professionals who want to build a career at the intersection of **Business Analysis \+ ERP \+ Technology \+ Business Process Transformation**.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person

title: AI Operations Associate — Voice Quality & Data
description:
**About InstaBus**

India's private intercity bus industry moves millions of passengers a day and still runs on phone calls, WhatsApp forwards and spreadsheets. We build AI products that change that.

Our first product, **InstaVoice**, is a 24×7 AI voice agent that speaks natural Hinglish and handles the entire passenger journey — booking confirmations, boarding point coordination, delay updates, feedback capture. It is live with real operators, on real routes, talking to real passengers every night.

We are a small team. What you own actually ships.

**The role:**

You are the human in the loop for an AI system that talks to thousands of passengers.

Two things depend on you: the data our AI agent speaks from, and the judgement call on whether it spoke well. Both are the difference between an AI product that operators trust and one they switch off.

This is not a ticket queue. You will sit between our operators, our AI and our product team, and you will be the first person to know when something is wrong.

**What you'll own**

1\. AI voice quality assurance

* Listen to live AI call recordings daily and assess them against a quality rubric — comprehension, response accuracy, tone, interruption handling, call resolution
* Identify failure modes: misheard place names, wrong language switches, dropped context mid\-call, awkward phrasing, voice quality issues
* Log, categorise and prioritise issues so the product team knows what to fix first
* Track whether fixes actually worked, call over call
* Flag anything that affects a passenger's real journey — immediately

Your notes directly shape what our engineers change in the agent. You are the closest thing we have to the passenger's ear.

2\. Passenger data operations

* Pull daily passenger manifests from operator GDS/back\-office systems across multiple bus operators and routes
* Use AI tooling (Claude) to clean, validate and standardise those manifests into our platform format — deduplication, phone merging, name normalisation, boarding/drop point mapping, agent vs. OTA classification
* Cross\-check every file against source totals and flag discrepancies *before* they reach the dashboard
* Push validated files to the InstaBus dashboard on schedule, including evening and night departure cycles
* Spot patterns in bad data and tell us how to fix them at source — most of our processing rules came from someone noticing something twice

You will not be doing this by hand. You'll be operating an AI\-assisted pipeline and being accountable for its output. Learning to prompt, correct and QA an AI system is a large part of the job.

**Who we're looking for**

* Fluent in **Hindi and English and Southern Regional Languages (esp. Kannada)**, comfortable with Hinglish as it is actually spoken — you'll be listening to calls, not reading transcripts
* Strong attention to detail. You notice when a number doesn't add up and you don't let it slide
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and willing to learn AI tools properly (we'll train you; curiosity matters more than existing skill)
* Able to write clearly — your issue logs are a product input, not a formality
* Self\-managing. We don't count hours — we count whether the file went up before the bus left. Buses run on schedule, so our data has to
* Any graduate. Freshers welcome

**Bonus:** exposure to travel/transport/logistics operations, customer support quality monitoring, or any hands\-on use of ChatGPT/Claude in real work.

**How we work**

**Hours and days are flexible.** We don't run a fixed shift. What we need is roughly 8 hours of real work a day and coverage of the departure cycles — manifests are pulled and uploaded through the morning, evening and late\-night slots, and calls are reviewed daily. You'll plan your own week in coordination with the rest of the team and our interns, so that someone is always covering the cycles. If you want to take a Wednesday off and work Saturday, that's a conversation, not a problem.

**Confidentiality is non\-negotiable.** You will handle real passenger names, phone numbers and travel details. That data stays inside our systems, always. We'll ask you to sign an NDA.

**Why this is worth your time**

* You'll learn AI operations from the inside — prompting, evaluation, quality rubrics, failure analysis. This is a fast\-growing skill set and very few people have real production experience in it
* Direct access to the founder and the product team. No layers
* Clear growth path into AI Operations Lead, Customer Success, or Product Operations as we scale across operators
* Early\-stage startup with paying customers and real deployments

Pay: From ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quality Assurance Engineers in die\-casting manufacturing ensure defect\-free production through rigorous inspections, process controls, and compliance. This sample job description is tailored for your small Indian firm, focusing on high\-pressure die casting challenges like porosity and tolerances.

(Quality assurance engineers can apply too)

Job Title and Summary

Quality Assurance Engineer

We seek a detail\-oriented QA Engineer to oversee quality in our die\-casting operations, VMC CNC Machine Shop \& Assembly. The role involves implementing QMS, conducting inspections, driving CAPA, and achieving KPIs in a fast\-paced shop floor environment.

Key Responsibilities

Maintain ISO 9001\-compliant QMS, SOPs for Die casting, trimming, machining and further finishing processes; conduct internal audits to confirm the compliance with the QMS.

Perform in\-process review and final inspections using CMM, gauges, and visual checks; apply SPC to monitor cycle times, pressures, and alloy temps.

Analyze defects via root cause tools like 5\-Why, 8D; implement CAPA and verify effectiveness.

Verify incoming materials (alloys, dies); handle customer NCRs and ensure quality \>95%.​

Train production teams on DFM; generate monthly KPI reports on Rejections, COPQ, and reject rates.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Technical Skills: Proficiency in SPC, CMM, Six Sigma Green Belt; knowledge of die\-casting \& machining defects, NADCA standards, and alloy specs (Al, Zn). Engineering drawing, Limits \& tolerances

Experience: 3\-5 years in manufacturing QA, preferably die casting/foundry; hands\-on with audits and CAPA.

(Experience for QC Engineers: 1\-3 years in manufacturing QC, preferably die casting/foundry, or a machine shop; knowledge of CAPA/Why\-why analysis.)

Soft Skills: Strong analytical/problem\-solving; excellent communication for reports and training; attention to detail.

Education: B.E. in Mechanical/Metallurgy; ISO 9001 Lead Auditor certification preferred.

Tools: Minitab/MS Excel for data analysis; familiarity with ERP/QMS software.

Preferred Qualifications :

Experience in Indian manufacturing with export compliance (IATF 16949 for auto parts).

Lean manufacturing knowledge to reduce COPQ

Report to Plant Manager; competitive salary based on Navi Mumbai market. Apply with resume highlighting die\-casting QA experience (or machining experience)

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹29,000\.00 per month

 We are seeking a hands\-on Data Engineer to join our team, focusing on building the robust foundations required for modern analytics and AI. In this role, you will bridge the gap between raw data and production\-ready AI solutions, architecting scalable pipelines that power machine learning models and business intelligence. You will be responsible for the engineering discipline that ensures data reliability, performance, and security within the Databricks ecosystem.

* AI/ML Pipeline Support: Architect, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines specifically designed to support AI/ML workflows, including feature engineering and model training datasets.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Total Experience: 1\-4 years in data engineering or related fields.
* Databricks Expertise: Solid experience with Databricks, focusing on platform engineering, data engineering, and analytics.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java; strong experience with Databricks APIs, Apache Spark, and Delta Lake.

* AI/ML Exposure: Practical experience supporting AI/ML lifecycles, including familiarity with ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) or MLOps practices.

**Good to Have** 



* Cloud Experience: Hands\-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP.

* Best\-in\-industry learning and growth opportunities.
* Comprehensive Health and wellness benefits, including medical insurance for self and family.

 We’re looking for a technically strong and security\-focused DevSecOps Engineer to embed, automate, and operationalize security across our CI/CD pipelines and cloud\-native environments.  We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.
   

  

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 Join PayPal’s Offensive Security team to help protect our products, applications, infrastructure, and emerging technologies. You’ll conduct hands\-on penetration testing and secure code reviews across web, mobile, APIs, cloud, infrastructure, and other environments. You’ll also validate findings from AI\-assisted code reviews and automated security tools, assessing exploitability and business impact while identifying complex vulnerabilities and business logic flaws. Working closely with engineering teams, you’ll translate findings into realistic attack scenarios and practical remediation guidance.

* Analyze and resolve security challenges by adapting standard processes and exploring alternative approaches to address complex threats.
* Influence the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the team through informed decision\-making, with a potential impact on other teams.
* Collaborate with other engineers to gather and incorporate feedback, driving continuous improvements in security processes.


**Minimum Qualifications:**

**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience conducting secure source\-code reviews and identifying complex vulnerabilities and business logic flaws.

* Familiarity with penetration\-testing methodologies and guidance such as PTES and OWASP.
* Proficiency in a scripting language such as Python, PowerShell, or Perl.
* Software development experience with languages or platforms such as Java or Node.js is preferred.
* Experience assessing AI/ML systems or using AI\-assisted security analysis and automation is a plus.
* Security certifications such as OSWE, OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CEH are a plus.
* Strong technical writing, communication, critical\-thinking, and attention\-to\-detail skills.


**Additional Responsibilities**

* Review and validate potential vulnerabilities identified through AI\-assisted code reviews and automated security tooling.
* Reproduce security findings and evaluate exploitability, business impact, severity, remediation priority, and potential false positives.

* Test authentication, authorization, session management, OAuth, OIDC, JWT, CSP, cryptography, and related application security controls.

* Document vulnerabilities with clear reproduction steps, realistic attack scenarios, technical context, and actionable remediation guidance.

description:
Role Purpose
 



 TAC Security is looking for a highly skilled
 **Security Engineer – OSCP Certified** 
 with strong hands\-on expertise in
 **penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, application security, network security, and offensive security** 
 .
 



 The Security Engineer will be responsible for identifying, validating, and demonstrating security vulnerabilities across web applications, APIs, mobile applications, networks, cloud environments, and infrastructure. The role requires a strong offensive\-security mindset, practical exploitation skills, and the ability to provide actionable remediation guidance to clients and internal teams.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



**1\. Vulnerability Assessment \& Penetration Testing** 



* Perform end\-to\-end
 **Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT)** 
 across applications and infrastructure.
* Conduct manual penetration testing rather than relying solely on automated scanning tools.
* Identify, validate, exploit, and document security vulnerabilities.
* Perform network and infrastructure penetration testing across internal and external environments.
* Conduct security testing of web applications, APIs, mobile applications, and cloud\-based environments.
* Perform vulnerability verification and retesting after remediation.
* Evaluate vulnerabilities based on technical severity, exploitability, and potential business impact.



**2\. Web Application \& API Security** 



* Perform advanced web application penetration testing aligned with
 **OWASP Top 10** 
 and relevant testing methodologies.
* Test for vulnerabilities including SQL Injection, XSS, SSRF, IDOR, authentication and authorization weaknesses, insecure deserialization, file\-upload vulnerabilities, business\-logic flaws, and security misconfigurations.
* Conduct API security assessments covering REST and other API architectures.
* Identify complex authorization, authentication, session\-management, and business\-logic vulnerabilities.



**3\. Network \& Infrastructure Security** 



* Conduct external and internal network penetration testing.
* Perform network enumeration, service discovery, vulnerability analysis, exploitation, and privilege escalation.
* Assess Windows and Linux environments for security weaknesses.
* Conduct
 **Active Directory security assessments** 
 and identify privilege\-escalation and lateral\-movement opportunities.
* Evaluate firewall configurations, exposed services, network segmentation, and infrastructure security controls.



**4\. Offensive Security \& Exploitation** 



* Apply OSCP\-level penetration\-testing techniques in real\-world environments.
* Perform manual exploitation, privilege escalation, pivoting, lateral movement, and post\-exploitation activities within approved scopes.
* Develop or modify scripts and proof\-of\-concept exploits when required.
* Use offensive\-security techniques responsibly and strictly within authorized testing environments.
* Maintain detailed evidence and attack paths throughout engagements.



**5\. Security Tools \& Technologies** 




 Hands\-on experience with tools such as:
 


* Burp Suite Professional
* Nmap
* Metasploit
* Nessus
* Kali Linux
* Wireshark
* BloodHound
* Impacket
* SQLMap
* Nikto
* Gobuster/Ffuf
* Hydra
* John the Ripper/Hashcat



 Candidates should understand the underlying techniques and be capable of performing manual validation rather than depending exclusively on tools.
 



**6\. Reporting \& Remediation** 



* Prepare detailed and professional penetration\-testing reports containing vulnerability descriptions, severity, evidence, proof of concept, business impact, and remediation recommendations.
* Assign severity using appropriate methodologies such as
 **CVSS** 
 .
* Conduct technical walkthroughs with customers, developers, security teams, and management.
* Work closely with engineering teams to explain vulnerabilities and recommend practical remediation.
* Perform remediation validation and closure testing.



**7\. Research \& Continuous Improvement** 



* Stay updated on emerging vulnerabilities, CVEs, exploitation techniques, attack methodologies, and cybersecurity threats.
* Research new offensive\-security techniques and tools.
* Contribute to internal security methodologies, testing checklists, knowledge bases, automation, and security research.
* Participate in internal knowledge\-sharing and technical training sessions.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
* **OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) certification is mandatory.**
* **3–7\+ years of hands\-on experience** 
 in penetration testing, VAPT, offensive security, or application security.
* Strong practical knowledge of:
* Web Application Penetration Testing
* API Security Testing
* Network Penetration Testing
* Active Directory Security
* Linux \& Windows Privilege Escalation
* Vulnerability Assessment
* Exploitation \& Post\-Exploitation
* OWASP Top 10
* CVSS
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, firewalls, VPNs, proxies, authentication protocols, and network architectures.
* Ability to write basic automation/exploitation scripts using
 **Python, Bash, or PowerShell** 
 .
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.



 Preferred Qualifications
 



 Additional certifications such as
 **OSWE, OSEP, CRTP/CRTE, PNPT, GPEN, GWAPT, CEH, or eJPT** 
 would be advantageous.
 



 Experience in one or more of the following would also be valuable: cloud penetration testing across AWS/Azure/GCP, mobile application security, source\-code review, DevSecOps/AppSec, red teaming, threat modeling, or secure\-code review.

**ABOUT US**


We're OakNorth, and we embolden entrepreneurs to realise their ambitions, understand their markets, and apply data intelligence to everyday decisions to scale successfully at pace. Banking should be barrier\-free — it's a belief at our very core, inspired by our entrepreneurial spirit, driven by the unmet financial needs of millions, and delivered by our data\-driven tools. We go beyond finance to empower our people, encourage professional growth, and create an environment where everyone can thrive.


**ABOUT THE TEAM**


The Corporate Finance team sits at the heart of OakNorth's financial operations, covering reporting, planning, and control across our UK and international entities. The team works closely with FP\&A, Treasury, Legal, Operations, and the business to ensure robust financial governance and continuous process improvement.


**ABOUT THE ROLE**


We are looking for an experienced Finance Controllership professional to join our Corporate Finance team. In this role you will own end\-to\-end accounting and reporting across both internal and external requirements — working under IFRS and Indian GAAP — while leading a broad array of planning projects and process improvement initiatives that directly support OakNorth's growth ambitions.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Own day\-to\-day accounting, month\-end closing, and periodic reporting in accordance with IFRS and Indian GAAP.
* Manage end\-to\-end accounting, valuation, and bank reconciliations for complex financial instruments including Investments, Borrowings, Loans, Deposits, and Derivatives (hedging compliance).
* Prepare Balance Sheet and P\&L items including prepayments, accruals, depreciation runs, intercompany entries, and other month\-end journals.
* Lead Fixed Assets and Intangible accounting, related schedules, and physical verifications; maintain General Ledger, vendor, and bank reconciliations.
* Support Statutory and Internal audits, preparing schedules, responding to auditor queries, and drafting internal notes/memos for approvals and audit evidence.
* Drive process standardisation and automation using data tools and AI\-enabled solutions in treasury and accounting workflows; draft and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (FP\&A, Operations, Legal, Credit/Portfolio Monitoring, Treasury, and the business) to identify process improvement opportunities and enhance the control environment.
* Prepare test scenarios and perform testing for system automation projects; assist with ad hoc projects as required.

**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**


* CA (Fresher)/CPA/MBA in Finance with 1\-5 years of progressive experience demonstrating strong accounting expertise and advanced financial analytical skills.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and MS Office skills with a focus on reporting automation; ability to prioritise and manage multiple workflows simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, with experience working across multiple functions and geographies in a fast\-paced organisation.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and results\-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement outlook; comfortable operating at scale with a hands\-on attitude and big\-picture thinking.

**Nice to Have**


* Background in the banking or financial services sector.
* Experience with or interest in data automation tools such as Python/Pandas or VBA for automating reconciliations and reporting processes.

**WHAT WE OFFER**


* **Health \& Protection:** Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* **Wellbeing:** Annual health check\-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* **Time Off:** Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* **Life Milestones:** Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* **Flexible Benefits:** Tax\-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* **Growth \& Development:** Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* **Our Workplace:** Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

title: Senior Systems Support Executive - IT Infrastructure
description:
**Roles \& Responsibilities**  
**1\. IT Infrastructure Management**

* Troubleshoot minor and major hardware breakdowns and ensure \>95% uptime by providing immediate rectification support — self or through external vendors for repair / replacement.
* Manage (installation, configuration, and support) all network devices, cloud servers, physical servers, software licenses, software databases, security solutions (anti\-virus, etc.), and other business software / subscriptions on various computers, Cloud Systems (AWS), and laptops with \>95% uptime, including Data Backup and Production Backup.
* Install, configure, and monitor system hardware, software, and networks on a routine basis to ensure optimal performance and application of security patch updates.
* Monitor system performance, capacity, and availability — proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks; prepare setup for VAPT (Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing).
* Evaluate and procure hardware servers, computers, laptops, peripheral devices, security automation tools / gadgets, etc. on behalf of the company with due approval on cost.
* Evaluate and procure software solutions, licenses, domains from registrars, and subscriptions on behalf of the company.
* Extend support for on\-site email installation and remote email server management / rectification.
* Management and maintenance of Data Backup and Restoration checks for on premise and cloud systems as per defined policy / process.
* Management of company's data and voice communication systems in liaison with AMC Partner / UPS / Cables.
* Manage physical positioning and inventory of computers, laptops, peripherals, and software — maintain an accurate and up\-to\-date Asset Inventory at all times.
* Timely submissions of internal reports, Subscription Renewal tracking and timely submission of CSP Evaluation with required details to the Reporting Head.
* Update all relevant trackers on a daily basis; raise CRF requests; perform Incident Reporting and timely escalation to the Reporting Head.

**2\. Information Security Posture \& Standards Management** 

* Own and maintain APT's Information Security posture across the organization in accordance with ISO 27001:2022 (ISMS) standards — as the designated custodian within APT.
* Document system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps — ensuring accurate and up\-to\-date documentation including Knowledge Base (KB), Trackers, Asset Inventory, and all components of the Network Diagram, as per the ISO process.
* Remediate OS and other security vulnerabilities on a proactive basis; apply security patches and updates within defined TATs; maintain a Vulnerability Register.
* Implement and enforce APT's Information Security Policy across all staff — covering data handling, access controls, acceptable use, and password management.
* Formulate and maintain IT Audit Checklists; undertake periodic technical audit checks of hardware, software, and network infrastructure; report findings to Reporting Head.
* Sensitize company staff on cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and best security practices for data management — conduct ISMS Awareness / InfoSec Awareness sessions for all staff including new joinees and freshers.
* Coordinate with external IT auditors, ISO consultants, and certification bodies during ISMS audits, surveillance audits, and renewal audits — compile and submit required evidence, records, and documentation.
* Maintain and update the Risk Register, Business Continuity Plan (BCP), and Disaster Recovery (DR) documentation as per ISO 27001 requirements.
* Ensure access control management — provisioning, modification, and de\-provisioning of system access for all employees, including joiners, transfers, and leavers — within defined TATs.
* Monitor and report on key Information Security metrics / KPIs to the Reporting Head on a periodic basis.

**3\. Team Support \& Knowledge Management** 

* Provide training and documented Knowledge Base (KB) to junior team members and new joiners — covering IT Infra processes, ISMS sessions, and systems orientation.
* Advice the Reporting Head on best management practices for internal systems infrastructure and information security posture.
* Provide weekend / extended support in cases of critical infrastructure incidents or security events.
* Carry out multitasking and prioritization of tasks effectively to meet deadlines — or as directed by the Reporting Head.

**Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* B.Sc. / B.Sc. (IT) / B.E. / B.Tech. / BCA / Computer Diploma / Technical Graduate or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in Systems, Hardware, Network, and Information Security Management.
* In\-depth knowledge of installing, configuring, and maintaining various hardware and network devices — network switches, access points, routers, firewalls, printers, scanners, etc. is a pre requisite.
* In\-depth knowledge of installing and maintaining various OS and SQL / Oracle databases is a pre\-requisite.
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows Server environments (2012–2022\), DNS, Active Directory, Domain Control, IIS, and Group Policy is a pre\-requisite.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP) — cloud server management, cloud backup, and cloud security configurations.
* Sound knowledge and practical experience of ISO 27001:2022 (ISMS) — implementation, internal auditing, and documentation is a strong requirement.
* Hands\-on experience with VAPT tools and vulnerability management is an added advantage.
* Sound skills of hardware / software troubleshooting and root\-cause diagnosis.
* Excellent analytical ability and on\-the\-spot thinking — ability to work effectively under pressure and resolve incidents within TATs.
* Basic computer skills, including professional email writing are a must.
* Sound communication, inter\-personal, and documentation skills.

**Added Advantage Qualification / Skill\-sets**

* ITIL Management Certification is a strong added advantage.
* Advanced knowledge of network communication, VLAN management, and network security architecture.
* Advanced knowledge of Server Management — Physical, Virtual (Hyper\-V / VMware), Cloud Server Management, and Email Server Management.
* Prior experience of managing IT infrastructure for 75–100 computers / laptops along with network devices simultaneously.
* Experience in coordinating BCP / DR drills and preparing DR runbooks.
* Familiarity with SIEM tools, endpoint security platforms, and DLP solutions.

title: Research & Data Operations Associate – Real Estate and Global Markets
description:
Work Arrangement

* Office\-based during the first 2 weeks
* Hybrid work may be allowed thereafter, subject to accuracy, reliability and performance
* Up to 4 work\-from\-home days per week after successful onboarding

Schedule

* Monday to Friday
* 10:00 AM–6:00 PM
* Occasional Saturday work from home may be required when mutually agreed

About NITARYA

NITARYA is building a research\-led advisory platform for global property ownership, second homes and international living decisions.

Our Library contains structured information about countries, provinces, cities, localities, property markets, developers and individual projects. This information supports internal research, public evaluations and client advisory reports.

Role Overview

We are looking for a methodical and dependable person who can research different markets, verify information, enter it into predefined templates and maintain the accuracy of our Library.

This is not a basic data\-entry role. The person must be able to locate credible sources, identify missing or conflicting information and record findings clearly. The role also involves obtaining updated inventory and project information from brokers, developers and other partners.

Key Responsibilities

* Research countries, states or provinces, cities, towns, villages and localities.
* Research individual real estate projects, developers and ownership structures.
* Collect information using standard templates provided by NITARYA.
* Use government websites, regulatory authorities, credible research reports and other reliable sources.
* Record source links, publication dates and evidence for important information.
* Upload and organise approved information in the NITARYA Library.
* Check entries for accuracy, completeness, duplication and formatting errors.
* Identify information that is outdated, inconsistent or unsupported.
* Conduct manual verification whenever automated or AI\-generated information is uncertain.
* Contact brokers and developers through email, WhatsApp or calls to obtain updated inventory, pricing, availability and project documents.
* Maintain inventory trackers and follow\-up records.
* Assist with creating and reviewing research\-based reports.
* Report system errors, missing fields or workflow problems noticed while using the platform.
* Maintain confidentiality and follow NITARYA’s research and data\-handling standards.

Required Skills

* Strong online research and information\-verification ability.
* Good written English and reading comprehension.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
* Ability to organise large amounts of information systematically.
* Attention to detail and patience with repetitive accuracy checks.
* Confidence in following up with brokers, developers and external partners.
* Ability to distinguish verified facts from marketing claims or assumptions.
* Comfort using AI tools for research assistance while independently verifying the output.
* Ability to work responsibly with limited supervision after training.

Educational Background

A bachelor’s degree in any relevant field, including:

* Economics
* Geography
* Business or Commerce
* Real Estate
* Urban Planning
* Finance
* Journalism
* Data or Information Management

Exceptional fresh graduates with strong research and communication skills may also apply.

Experience

* 0–2 years of relevant experience
* Experience in market research, real estate, data operations, due diligence or research\-based content is preferred
* Freshers may apply if they can demonstrate strong research ability

This Role Is Suitable for Someone Who

* Enjoys investigating and organising information.
* Questions unsupported claims rather than copying them.
* Can follow detailed templates without changing the prescribed structure.
* Is comfortable performing both research and operational follow\-ups.
* Takes ownership of accuracy and completes work on time.
* Wants to learn about international property markets and global living.

This Role May Not Suit Someone Who

* Treats research as copying information from the first Google result.
* Depends entirely on AI\-generated answers without checking sources.
* Dislikes structured templates, detailed checking or follow\-ups.
* Requires continuous supervision for routine work.
* Is looking for a sales\-only or property\-brokerage role.

Probation

Three months

Continuation and hybrid\-work eligibility will depend on research accuracy, reliability, productivity and adherence to processes.

Selection Process

* Application screening
* Short introductory interview
* Brief research and data\-entry assessment
* Final discussion

The assessment will test source selection, information verification, clarity and attention to detail.

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

* Are you able to work from our Pitampura office during the initial 2\-week training period?
* How many years of experience do you have in research, data operations or real estate?
* Are you comfortable contacting/calling brokers and developers across different countries for information and follow\-ups?
* What is your current monthly salary?

\# Social Media \& Content Manager / Founder’s Office Executive

\*\*Location:\*\* Cuttack, Odisha

\*\*Job Type:\*\* Full\-time \| On\-site

\*\*Experience:\*\* 1–3 years preferred

\*\*Industry:\*\* Education / Preschool / Parenting / Personal Brand

\#\# About the Role

We are looking for a \*\*creative, proactive, organised and digitally savvy Social Media \& Content Manager / Founder’s Office Executive\*\* to take ownership of the day\-to\-day digital presence of our school, parenting initiatives and associated platforms.

This is an \*\*in\-house role working closely with the Founder.\*\*

The selected candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, creating, publishing and monitoring content across \*\*Instagram, Facebook and YouTube\*\*, while also managing the online community, collaborations and digital growth initiatives.

The role will also involve \*\*Personal Assistant / Founder’s Office responsibilities\*\*, including coordination, scheduling, follow\-ups and day\-to\-day assistance to the Founder.

The candidate will have support from \*\*internal team members for shoots, content production and other execution requirements\*\*, but will be expected to take ownership of the planning, coordination, quality and timely execution of the overall digital function.

\-\-\-

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\#\#\# 1\. Social Media Management

\* Manage the day\-to\-day social media presence across:

\* Instagram

\* Facebook

\* YouTube

\* Other relevant digital platforms

\* Develop and maintain a \*\*monthly and weekly content calendar\*\*.

\* Plan content around school activities, events, festivals, education, parenting, children, community initiatives and campaigns.

\* Create and schedule posts, Reels, Stories, short\-form videos and other relevant content.

\* Write or coordinate captions, hooks, descriptions and basic social media copy.

\* Ensure consistency in brand voice, visual identity and communication.

\* Stay updated with social media trends, formats, features and content opportunities.

\#\#\# 2\. Content Creation \& Video Production

\* Plan and coordinate regular \*\*in\-house shoots\*\*.

\* Identify what content needs to be captured and when.

\* Shoot basic photos and videos using smartphones/cameras.

\* Coordinate with teachers, staff and the internal content team during shoots.

\* Have basic knowledge of lighting, framing, audio and video\-making.

\* Create or coordinate short\-form videos and Reels.

\* Have basic knowledge of video editing tools such as \*\*CapCut, VN, Canva, InShot, Premiere Pro or similar platforms\*\*.

\* Be comfortable working with basic equipment such as tripod, lights, microphones and mobile shooting accessories.

\* Coordinate with external professionals whenever specialised production is required.

\*\*Note:\*\* The candidate will not be expected to do everything alone. Internal team members will be available to support content shoots and execution. The candidate will be responsible for \*\*planning, directing, coordinating and ensuring completion.\*\*

\#\#\# 3\. YouTube Management

\* Assist in planning and managing the YouTube channel.

\* Develop ideas for long\-form and short\-form video content.

\* Coordinate video shoots and uploads.

\* Write basic titles, descriptions and other supporting content.

\* Understand the fundamentals of YouTube Shorts, thumbnails, titles, retention and engagement.

\* Monitor channel performance and recommend improvements.

\#\#\# 4\. Community Management

\* Monitor and respond to comments, messages and DMs across platforms.

\* Engage with parents, followers and the wider community.

\* Identify important questions, concerns, feedback and opportunities.

\* Maintain a positive and professional online presence.

\* Encourage meaningful conversations and community engagement.

\* Track relevant inquiries and leads generated through social media.

\#\#\# 5\. Collaborations \& Digital Growth

\* Identify relevant influencers, creators, educators, parenting communities and potential collaborators.

\* Research and propose suitable collaboration opportunities.

\* Coordinate with collaborators and manage communication/follow\-ups.

\* Monitor relevant trends and opportunities for the school and Founder.

\* Suggest new content formats and campaigns to improve reach and engagement.

\* Explore opportunities for cross\-promotion and community building.

\#\#\# 6\. Analytics, Reporting \& Performance

A key responsibility of this role will be \*\*monitoring performance and providing clear reporting.\*\*

The candidate will:

\* Track reach, views, engagement, follower growth and other relevant metrics.

\* Identify high\-performing and low\-performing content.

\* Understand basic social media analytics.

\* Provide \*\*weekly performance updates\*\*.

\* Prepare a \*\*monthly social media performance report\*\*.

\* Recommend what should be continued, changed or stopped based on data.

\* Maintain a clear record of content published, performance and upcoming plans.

We are looking for someone who understands that \*\*social media is not just about posting — it is about measuring, learning and improving.\*\*

\-\-\-

\#\# 7\. Founder’s Office / Personal Assistant Responsibilities

The candidate will work closely with the Founder and will also assist with selected professional and personal\-assistant responsibilities.

These may include:

\* Managing and coordinating the Founder’s calendar.

\* Scheduling meetings, calls and appointments.

\* Coordinating shoots, events and engagements.

\* Following up with team members, vendors, collaborators and external contacts.

\* Maintaining task lists and ensuring timely follow\-ups.

\* Coordinating information between the Founder and internal teams.

\* Assisting with day\-to\-day communication and organisation.

\* Helping ensure important commitments, deadlines and follow\-ups are not missed.

\-\-\-

\# Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for someone who is:

\* \*\*Creative and curious\*\*

\* Proactive and takes initiative

\* Highly organised and good at follow\-ups

\* Comfortable working directly with a Founder

\* Social\-media savvy and aware of current trends

\* Comfortable with both \*\*content creation and coordination\*\*

\* Good at communicating with people

\* Willing to learn and experiment

\* Able to manage multiple priorities

\* Responsible, trustworthy and discreet

\* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment

\* Someone who looks at a problem and thinks \*\*"How can I solve this?"\*\* rather than waiting for instructions

\#\# Required Skills

\*\*Essential:\*\*

\* Good understanding of Instagram and Facebook

\* Basic understanding of YouTube and YouTube Shorts

\* Basic video\-making and shooting skills

\* Basic video editing skills

\* Familiarity with Canva and/or basic design tools

\* Understanding of Reels, Stories and short\-form content

\* Basic knowledge of social media analytics

\* Good written and verbal communication

\* Strong organisational and coordination skills

\* Good working knowledge of English

\* Ability to work on\-site

\*\*Good to Have:\*\*

\* Experience managing a brand's social media pages

\* Experience in education, preschool, parenting, lifestyle or personal branding

\* Experience with YouTube content

\* Photography/videography experience

\* Experience with CapCut, VN, Premiere Pro or similar editing software

\* Experience coordinating influencer/creator collaborations

\* Experience working directly with a Founder/entrepreneur

\* Knowledge of Meta Business Suite and social media scheduling tools

\-\-\-

\# What This Role Is NOT

This is \*\*not simply a posting or scheduling job.\*\*

We are not looking for someone who waits for a brief, creates one post and waits for the next instruction.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership and say:

\*\*"Here is our content plan for this week."\*\*

\*\*"This content is performing well — let's create more around it."\*\*

\*\*"Our engagement has dropped — let's analyse why."\*\*

\*\*"There is an opportunity for a collaboration here."\*\*

title: Dispatch Network Technician - L1 (Break Fix Support)
description:
**Job Description**
 Note: The job role is Part Time only (On Demand Support)
   

  

 Maintains computing environment by identifying network requirements, installing upgrades, and monitoring network performance.
   

  

**Break\-fix**
**Job Responsibilities:**
* Visually inspecting devices to assess equipment status
* Rebooting routers, servers, storage devices or other equipment
* Providing loop\-back cables in order to test circuits remotely
* Re\-seating or replacing components or cables
* Removing Alternating Current (“AC”) or Direct Current (“DC”) power from equipment
* Cleaning equipment or connectors
* Connecting a client\-provided test set or test router to equipment
* Swapping removable storage media
* Installing or replace modular equipment components
* Dispatching equipment for repair
* Cleaning fibers
* Taking light levels
* Installing loop backs
* Providing planned maintenance or circuit migration support
* Installing Small Form Factor Pluggable (each an “SFP”) or Gigabit Interface Converters (each a “GBIC”)
* Troubleshooting hardware problems on any device
* Racking and de\-racking of any device installed
* Labeling/inventory equipment plus digital picture and serial number recording
* Tape backup: cassette exchange and storage in strongbox
* Power cycling a router, server, switch and soft\-booting a server
* Follow Data Eradication process


**Provisioning**
* Install cables or optics for new circuits
* Re\-connect / disconnect / replace existing circuits
* Testing of cables and optics


**Deployment**
* Physical Cabling
* Cable Management
* Northbound Cabling (Fiber/Copper/Power)
* Rack/Stack/Jack
* Installation Support (PDU, Network Switches, etc.)
* E\-Waste and other clean\-up activities


**Job Requirements**
* Proven experience in a network administrator role
* Hands on experience in networking, routing and switching
* Excellent knowledge of best practices around management, control, and monitoring of server infrastructure
* Experience with firewalls, Internet VPN’s remote implementation, troubleshooting, and problem resolution is desired
* Ability to set up and configure server hardware
* Familiarity with backup and recovery software and methodologies
* Great at organizing, prioritizing and multitasking
* CCNA, Network\+ or equivalent
* BSc degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent
* Associate's degree (A.A.) or equivalent from three\-year College or technical school with an emphasis in electronics required; Bachelor's Degree preferred

description:
**Who we are** 






 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 





**Job summary** 






 We are seeking a Software Engineer with 2 years\+ of experience to join our Public Trust PKI engineering team. The team develops and maintains certificate issuance that power DigiCert's PKI platform. In this role, you will contribute to backend services responsible for certificate lifecycle operations, working primarily in C\+\+ while collaborating with teams developing Java and Go\-based microservices. You will participate in the design, development, testing, and support of highly available and scalable services operating in a distributed environment.

* Good understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.

* Experience using Git\-based source control workflows.

title: Back End Developer
description:
**About the role** 




 We're looking for a backend engineer who can take real ownership of features and modules end\-to\-end \- from schema design to API implementation to production support. You'll work in a codebase built around multi\-tenancy, scoped authorization, and AI\-driven workflows, and contribute to architectural decisions within the direction set by our senior engineers.
 



  





 The work is technically substantial. You'll spend time on genuinely hard problems: multi\-tenant data isolation, permission systems that go beyond simple role checks, integrations with government systems that Indian institutes are required to use, and backend services that support AI\-powered features.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




 • Build backend services in Node.js and NestJS against a PostgreSQL data layer
 



 • Design and implement APIs that serve multiple tenants with logically isolated data
 



 • Work on authorization systems \- scoped role assignments, permission caching, audit logging
 



 • Integrate with external systems including payment gateways, identity providers, communication
 



 platforms, and government services
 



 • Build async workflows using message queues and background workers
 



 • Contribute to backend services that orchestrate AI features (working with LLMs via provider APIs)
 



 • Write tests, review code, participate in architecture discussions
 



 • Support production systems used by real customers \- read logs, debug incidents, own the fixes
 



  





**Required experience** 




 • 3\-5 years of professional Node.js development, with production NestJS experience
 



 • Strong PostgreSQL: schema design, query optimization, indexing, transactions
 



 • Solid understanding of authorization patterns beyond simple role checks (scoped permissions,
 



 hierarchical roles, or equivalent complexity)
 



 • Experience with async workflows \- message queues, background jobs, event\-driven patterns (BullMQ, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Pub/Sub)
 



 • Redis for caching, sessions, and rate limiting
 



 • Writing and maintaining test suites (unit and integration)
 



 • Production experience: comfortable reading logs, debugging live issues, owning what you ship
 



 • Git\-based collaborative workflow, code review discipline, clear PR descriptions
 



 • Strong written English \- you'll write design notes, PR descriptions, and technical documentation
 



  





**Strongly preferred (any two of these)** 




 • Multi\-tenant SaaS experience \- you should have opinions on schema\-per\-tenant vs database\-per\-
 



 tenant trade\-offs
 



 • Shipped features integrating with LLMs in production (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or equivalent)• Worked in a regulated domain (ed\-tech, fintech, healthcare) where compliance affects data modeling
 



 • Comfortable with modular monolith architecture and microservices
 



  





**Nice to have** 




 • pgvector or another vector database
 



 • Docker and containerized deployments
 



 • Cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS or Azure acceptable)
 



 • CI/CD pipelines
 



 • Prior exposure to Indian regulatory frameworks (DPDP, UGC compliance, DigiLocker integrations)
 



 • Experience generating API type definitions from OpenAPI specs, or publishing internal npm packages for cross\-repo type sharing
 



  





**Who thrives in this role** 




 • Engineers who want architectural depth without waiting years to earn it
 



 • People who take ownership seriously \- you're responsible for what you ship, including how it behaves in production
 



 • Engineers who care about code that other people have to read, not just code that works
 



 • Anyone who wants to work on AI\-integrated backends before it becomes standard everywhere.

title: SolarSquare Energy - Software Development Engineer III - Backend Technologies
description:
**Role : Software Development Engineer III (SDE3\)**
**Location : Mumbai / Bangalore \| Experience : 4\+ Years**
**About SolarSquare**
 At SolarSquare we are building the Home\-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full\-stack D2C residential solar brand \- designing, installing, maintaining (after\-sales) and financing solar systems for home\-owners across India.
   

  

 In 3 years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission.
   

  

**What This Role Is**
 You are an engineer who leads projects at the scope of a service or major subsystem. That means : when a problem lands on your desk, it's usually ambiguous. Your job is to turn it into a clear problem statement, design a system to solve it, ship it through to production, and own how it behaves once it's there. You'll work with one or two engineers on most projects, and you'll be the technical person product, ops, and other engineering teams talk to about that domain. You're not a senior individual contributor who only writes code for assigned tickets. You're not a tech lead who's stopped writing code. You're the person between those two \- still hands\-on, but increasingly the one shaping what gets built.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Solve 2 \- 4 complex problems a year end\-to\-end : shape the problem, design the system, ship it, monitor it.
* Design single\-service systems independently. Define API contracts, data models, scale and reliability requirements. Document and review your design with peers before building.
* Turn ambiguity into clarity. Take half\-formed product tasks and partner with PMs to define what's actually being built. Push back when the ask doesn't make sense.
* Stay hands\-on. Write code that goes into production. Drive code reviews. Debug across service boundaries. Refactor when the codebase needs it.
* Mentor 1 \- 2 junior engineers. Be someone's first reviewer. Pair when it helps. Take their growth as your responsibility, not a side activity.
* Be in hiring. Interview candidates regularly. Help shape the interview bar for your function.
* Own outcomes, not output. Track the business or operational metric your work moves. If it doesn't move, that's a problem you own \- not a problem you delivered to.

title: Robotics Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




 We build training data to train the next generation of Vision Language Actions (VLA) and World
 



 Foundation Models (WFMs). It is one of the hardest open problems in physical AI.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




 You will build hardware systems fast. You will work on real, messy, failure\-prone systems that
 



 need to work reliably. You’ll pick sensors, read datasheets, wire things up, break them, and fix
 



 them repeatedly until they work. You’ll integrate sensors with microcontrollers and single\-board
 



 computers, bring up systems from scratch, and debug across hardware and software
 



 boundaries. Expect to move quickly from idea to prototype, iterate under pressure, and make
 



 pragmatic engineering decisions. You’ll also handle basic 3D design when needed to make
 



 systems usable in the real world. This role is about ownership, where you don’t wait for
 



 instructions, you figure things out and ship working hardware.
 



  





**Who We Want** 




 We’re looking for builders, who should be comfortable getting your hands dirty \- reading
 



 datasheets, debugging hardware issues, and working through ambiguity without step\-by\-step
 



 guidance. You’ve likely built things on your own (robots, IoT systems, embedded projects,
 



 anything real), and you understand how components come together beyond theory. You don’t
 



 give up when things don’t work the first time (they won’t). You can move fast, learn faster, and
 



 care about making things actually work and not just look good on paper.
 



 Bonus if you’ve worked with embedded systems, sensors, or done any kind of full\-stack or
 



 ML\-adjacent work \- but the most important thing is that you can build and figure things out
 



 independently.

title: Pharmacist
description:
**Job Title:** Pharmacist

**Location:** Gurgaon, Haryana  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** Pharmacy Manager / Chief Pharmacist

**Job Purpose:** We are looking for a licensed and detail\-oriented Pharmacist to manage our pharmacy operations, dispense medications accurately, and provide excellent patient care. You will be responsible for reviewing prescriptions, advising patients on medicine usage, managing inventory, and ensuring strict compliance with the **Drugs and Cosmetics Act** and other state pharmacy regulations.

**Key Responsibilities1\. Medication Dispensing \& Patient Care**

* **Prescription Review:** Screen prescriptions for correct dosage, potential drug interactions, allergies, and legal validity.
* **Accurate Dispensing:** Accurately compound (if applicable), pack, and label medications as prescribed by registered medical practitioners.
* **Patient Counseling:** Advise patients on correct dosages, side effects, storage conditions, and instructions for chronic disease medications (e.g., diabetes, hypertension).
* **OTC Guidance:** Provide safe and professional guidance on over\-the\-counter (OTC) medicines and healthcare products.

**2\. Inventory \& Stock Management**

* **Stock Monitoring:** Maintain optimum inventory levels, track slow\-moving products, and raise orders to prevent stock\-outs of life\-saving drugs.
* **Expiry Control:** Implement strict **FEFO (First Expired, First Out)** practices to minimize medicine wastage and systematically isolate expired items.
* **Cold Chain Maintenance:** Monitor and log refrigerator temperatures daily to ensure the efficacy of vaccines, insulin, and other temperature\-sensitive medicines.

**3\. Compliance \& Record Keeping**

* **Narcotics Management:** Maintain precise records and registers for Schedule H, H1, and X drugs as per Indian pharmacy laws.
* **Billing \& Systems:** Generate accurate invoices using pharmacy management software (ERP) and process insurance claims where applicable.
* **Audits:** Participate in periodic internal and external stock and regulatory audits.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** **B.Pharm (Bachelor of Pharmacy)** or **D.Pharm (Diploma in Pharmacy)** from a PCI\-recognized institution.
* **Licensure:** **Mandatory Active Registration** as a Registered Pharmacist with the **Haryana State Pharmacy Council (HSPC)** or a transferable registration from another state council.
* **Experience:** 1 to 4 years (Freshers are welcome for Junior Pharmacist roles; 2\+ years preferred for Hospital/Senior roles).
* **Technical Skills:** Familiarity with pharmacy retail software (like Marg ERP, eVital, or SAP) and basic MS Office tools.
* **Soft Skills:** High attention to detail, strong communication skills (Hindi \& English), patience, and a service\-oriented mindset.

**Work Environment \& Physical Demands**

* Flexibility to work in **rotational shifts**, including night shifts (especially in 24/7 hospital pharmacies or quick\-commerce dark stores).
* Ability to stand for extended periods during peak pharmacy hours.

\* Schedule meetings/demos/callbacks whenever required.

\* Convert qualified leads into customers.

\* Meeting Scheduled

\* Converted

\* Make outbound calls.

\* Speak with prospects.

\* Understand their requirements.

\* Explain the product/service.

\* Handle objections.

\* Schedule meetings or demos.

\* Follow up with previous leads.

\* Update CRM after every interaction.

\*\*End of Day\*\*

\* Update CRM.

\* Follow\-ups completed.

\* Meetings/demos scheduled.

\* Leads converted.

\* Revenue generated.

\* CRM data accuracy.

\* Daily attendance and punctuality.
