title: Lab Chemist
description:
We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic B.Sc. Chemistry fresher to join our Quality Control / Laboratory team at our food manufacturing plant. The candidate will be responsible for assisting in routine laboratory testing, quality checks, sample analysis, and maintaining proper laboratory records to ensure compliance with quality and food safety standards.

The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of chemistry, good observation skills, willingness to learn, and the ability to work in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities1\. Laboratory Testing \& Analysis

* Assist in routine chemical and physical testing of raw materials, in\-process materials, and finished food products.
* Conduct basic laboratory tests under the guidance of senior chemists.
* Assist in testing parameters such as pH, acidity, moisture, fat, and other applicable quality parameters.
* Handle laboratory instruments and equipment carefully as per standard procedures.
* Ensure proper sampling, labelling, and storage of samples.

2\. Quality Control

* Assist the QC team in checking the quality of incoming raw materials and finished products.
* Support quality checks during different stages of production.
* Report abnormal test results or deviations to the concerned senior.
* Follow approved SOPs, quality procedures, and food safety guidelines.
* Maintain cleanliness and hygiene in the laboratory and assigned work areas.

3\. Documentation \& Records

* Maintain daily laboratory testing records and registers.
* Record test results accurately and ensure proper documentation.
* Assist in preparing quality reports and maintaining sample records.
* Support the team in maintaining calibration and equipment usage records.
* Ensure laboratory documents are updated and properly maintained.

4\. Safety \& Compliance

* Follow laboratory safety procedures while handling chemicals and equipment.
* Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Handle chemicals, glassware, and laboratory instruments responsibly.
* Follow company policies, GMP, hygiene, and food safety practices.
* Report any laboratory safety concerns to the reporting manager.

5\. Learning \& Development

* Learn laboratory testing methods and food quality parameters.
* Develop practical knowledge of dairy and food product quality testing.
* Assist senior team members in investigations of quality deviations.
* Participate in training related to quality control, food safety, and laboratory practices.

Eligibility Criteria

* B.Sc. in Chemistry from a recognized university.
* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Basic knowledge of Organic, Inorganic, and Analytical Chemistry.
* Basic understanding of laboratory testing and chemical handling.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and MS Word.
* Willingness to work in a food manufacturing plant and learn laboratory operations.
* Candidates residing in or around Hooghly, Bardhaman, or nearby areas may be preferred.

Required Skills

* Basic laboratory knowledge.
* Attention to detail.
* Good analytical and observation skills.
* Ability to follow instructions and SOPs.
* Good record\-keeping ability.
* Teamwork and discipline.
* Willingness to learn and take responsibility.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.
* Ability to work in rotational shifts
* Candidates are required to stay close to the plant.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Business Development Executive - Sales Hunter (Fresher)
description:
We are looking for a **high\-energy Sales Hunter** who loves finding new opportunities, starting conversations, and turning prospects into customers.

This is **not a passive sales or customer\-support role**. You will be responsible for actively finding potential clients, reaching out to them, generating meetings, understanding their requirements, and helping close new business.

You will work directly with the founders and senior team and get hands\-on experience in selling **web development, mobile applications, software development, UI/UX, gamification, AI solutions, and other technology services**.

If you are someone who enjoys talking to strangers, is comfortable hearing "no", follows up relentlessly, and gets excited when you close a deal, this role is for you.

What You Will Do1\. Hunt for New Business

* Identify companies and decision\-makers who could benefit from our IT services.
* Build prospect lists using LinkedIn, Google, directories, databases, and other sources.
* Identify founders, CEOs, CMOs, CTOs, marketing heads, and other relevant decision\-makers.
* Research prospects before reaching out to understand their business and potential technology requirements.
* Continuously build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

2\. Outbound Sales

* Make **cold calls** to prospective clients.
* Send personalized cold emails and LinkedIn messages.
* Conduct outbound campaigns targeting companies in India and international markets.
* Experiment with different messaging, industries, geographies, and outreach channels.
* Follow up consistently with prospects until they respond or the opportunity is closed/lost.
* Turn cold prospects into qualified conversations and meetings.

3\. Qualify \& Convert Opportunities

* Speak with prospects to understand their business challenges and technology requirements.
* Qualify leads based on need, budget, timeline, decision\-making authority, and fit.
* Schedule discovery calls and meetings.
* Present our services and explain how we can solve the prospect's problem.
* Coordinate with the technology/product team when technical inputs are required.
* Prepare proposals and quotations with the support of the senior team.
* Negotiate and follow through until the deal is closed.

4\. Own Your Pipeline

You will be expected to take ownership of your numbers.

Track:

* Prospects contacted
* Calls made
* Emails/messages sent
* Conversations started
* Qualified leads
* Meetings booked
* Proposals sent
* Deals closed
* Revenue generated

You will use our CRM and sales tracking systems to maintain the pipeline.

What Makes You a Good Fit

We are looking for **attitude and sales hunger more than experience**.

You should:

* Be highly ambitious and motivated by targets.
* Be comfortable making cold calls.
* Enjoy talking to new people.
* Have excellent verbal and written communication.
* Be persistent and comfortable handling rejection.
* Have strong follow\-up discipline.
* Be curious about businesses and how technology can solve business problems.
* Be proactive rather than waiting for leads to be handed to you.
* Be comfortable with targets and performance\-based incentives.
* Have the ability to work independently and create your own opportunities.

We Especially Want Someone Who Thinks:"If there are no leads, I'll find them."

rather than:

"I'll wait for marketing to give me leads."Fresher? That's Absolutely Fine.

You don't need previous IT sales experience.

If you have participated in:

* College sales/marketing activities
* Entrepreneurship
* Business competitions
* Student organizations
* Fundraising
* Event sponsorship sales
* Telecalling
* Internships
* Freelancing
* Any activity where you had to convince or sell something

that's a plus.

What matters most is your **drive, communication, persistence, and willingness to learn**.

Must\-Have Skills

* Excellent communication
* Cold calling confidence
* Prospect research
* Lead generation
* Follow\-up
* Negotiation
* Relationship building
* Basic Excel/Google Sheets
* LinkedIn proficiency
* Willingness to work with sales targets

Good to Have

* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Apollo
* HubSpot / Zoho / other CRM experience
* Cold email tools
* Understanding of B2B sales
* Basic understanding of websites, mobile apps, SaaS, AI, or software development

Targets \& Incentives

This is a **target\-driven sales role**.

You will have clear KPIs around:

**Prospecting → Outreach → Conversations → Meetings → Opportunities → Closures → Revenue**

In addition to fixed compensation, you will be eligible for **performance\-based sales incentives**.

High performers will have the opportunity to grow rapidly into a **Business Development Manager / Sales Manager** role.

Why Join Us?

* Work directly with founders and senior leadership.
* Learn how B2B technology services are actually sold.
* Get exposure to Indian and international clients.
* Own your sales pipeline from prospecting to closure.
* Performance\-driven growth and incentives.
* Opportunity to build a career in high\-value B2B sales.

The Ideal Candidate

You don't need to be the person with the best resume.

We want the person who is:

**Hungry. Persistent. Curious. Competitive. Comfortable with rejection.**

If you believe you can pick up the phone, call a stranger, start a conversation, and create a business opportunity from scratch, **apply.**

This is not marketing role but a Sales role.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable making 30–50 cold calls per day?
* Are you comfortable reaching out to prospects through LinkedIn and cold email?
* Are you comfortable working with monthly sales targets and performance\-based incentives?

We do over INR 1000 crore\+ GMV (sales) and are growing rapidly.
 



  





 Our strong business model and focus on delivering excellent customer experience has facilitated our sustainable growth funded by internal cashflows. To fuel innovation and growth, we have raised USD 5\.5mn\+ funds from marquee global investors!

* Super passionate team with deep conviction which has stayed together during covid.

* Senior Product Manager \- 35\-50 LPA
* Product Manager \- 21\-35 LPA

* Product Analyst \- 7\-14 LPA



  





**About us** 




  





 The founding team has aced their respective leadership roles at successful internet startups in India, which are as follows:
 


* Ashish: Cofounder, leads technology, Ex CTO Cars24, CTO FabFurnish, Gaadi.
* Arun: Cofounder, leads product, Ex Cars24, TravelTriangle, TripFactory, IIM Bangalore.
* Chirag: Cofounder, leads business, Ex Oyo, TravelTriangle, IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Roorkee.

* Akshat: Director Engineering, 16\+ yrs Tech exp, Ex Cars24, L\&T, Samsung US, Motorola US.
* Rajesh:Director Engineering, 15\+ yrs Tech exp, Ex Hike, Foodpanda



  





**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 




  





 As a PM you would be managing a specific product (Flight / Hotel / Holiday etc) and be responsible for delivering Business KPIs (GMV /Revenue / Growth / Retention). To do well in the role, one needs to:
 



  




* Be a CEO of the product (business) and drive business results by working with business /marketing / content etc teams.
* Understand consumer \& business over tech
* Know importance of functionality over aesthetics
* Build Product in an MVP / iterative approach, Plan, Release, Feedback, Iterate
* Think in business logic first, translate real\-world scenarios (pricing, cancellations, refunds, supplier terms) into clear product rules, with enough structure that engineering can build it without back\-and\-forth
* Work closely with engineering to review vendor/supplier data quality, debug integration issues, and validate that what's built actually works as intended on the ground
* Be comfortable working with data, analyzing funnels, retention, failure rates, and search/booking trends to find what's broken and prioritize accordingly, not just relying on anecdotal feedback.
* Communicate directly and clearly with vendors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders (commercial, ops, leadership), including flagging issues, negotiating fixes, and writing things up in a way non\-technical stakeholders can act on
* Be able to actually build with AI, prototype working product flows, internal tools, or automations using AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit etc.) instead of only writing specs and waiting on engineering bandwidth for every idea.
* Identify workflows (internal ops, content, customer support, data reconciliation, supplier onboarding etc.) that can be redesigned or automated using AI agents, and be able to build a first version yourself to prove it out before pulling in a dev team
* Treat "let me build a quick prototype" as the default response to a new idea, not "let me write a PRD", use AI to compress the idea\-to\-working\-version timeline from weeks to days
* Bring an agentic mindset to problems, think in terms of AI systems that can independently execute multi\-step tasks (e.g., auto\-reconciling bookings, auto\-drafting vendor communication,auto\-flagging data anomalies), not just single\-shot AI assistance.



  





**Check if you fit in the role**

* Have 3\-6 years of experience in Product Management, preferably in a startup.
* Enjoy hands on execution with tech, business and marketing teams to deliver results
* Enjoy speaking directly with customers not just for "feedback or survey" but even for "sales / solving escalations and account management"
* Be able to prioritize, using data \& customer interactions
* Be able to go from idea to working prototype yourself using AI tools, rather than waiting for a formal handoff to engineering for every build



  





**You Can** 




  




* Design basic UI/UX yourself for prototypes and internal tools, using AI tools to generate mockups or working front\-ends without needing a dedicated designer
* Get into details to create detailed product documentation and user stories for tech.



  





**You Want to** 




  




* Improve your business acumen
* Drive results \& projects from ideation to execution
* Build things yourself instead of only specifying them, treat AI as leverage to move from "product manager" to someone who ships working software independently



  





**This role is not ideal for someone who is** 




  




* Not excited about working closely with tech and business teams to executelooking for a role to drive "strategy." We are a startup. Execution is everything
* Not comfortable with long working hours.
* Not excited about working on Saturdays (6 days a week). Yes Product is 6 days working (but
* Tech is not) as Product is expected to solve business challenges /grow the business
* Only comfortable writing specs and handing off, someone who wants engineering to build every version 1, rather than proving it out themselves first with AI



  





**Important Points:**

title: Product Designer (UI/UX)
description:
****Lyzr, in a minute****
 Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents software that handles real tasks on its own to work in their everyday operations. Most companies' AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day\-to\-day use. Today, 500\+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.
   

  

 Agentic software has no settled design language yet. How a person delegates work to an agent, follows what it did, and decides whether to trust the result are questions the industry is still answering. This role sits directly on those questions.
   

  

****The role****
 You will design the surfaces enterprise teams use to build, run, and supervise AI agents. This is a product design role, not a visual execution role: you will be handed problems, not specifications, and you will be expected to frame them before you open Figma.
   

  

 You will join a small design team, which means real scope from week one and no queue between you and the product decisions that matter.
   

  

* Team: Product
* Experience: 2–4 years
* Location \& work mode: Bengaluru, hybrid


****What will make you win this role****
 These are the core requirements the substance of the job.
   

  

* 2–4 years in product design, UI/UX, or interaction design. Shipped product work, not concept work. We will look at what went live and what changed because of it.
* Product thinking, evidenced. You can walk us through a problem you were given, how you framed it, the options you rejected, and why the version that shipped was the right one. Craft matters; judgement matters more.
* B2B SaaS, enterprise, or AI product experience. You have designed for users who are doing their job in your product, under constraints permissions, workflows, data density, edge cases not for consumers browsing.
* Interaction design and information architecture depth. Complex systems, dense states, and multi\-step flows are where you are strongest. You think in systems, not screens.
* Fluent in Figma and modern prototyping tools. Figma at a production standard, plus whatever you use to make an idea feel real before it is built.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging interaction patterns. You have opinions about how people should work with agents, and you are actively forming them.


****Cherry on top****
 Not screening criteria but they will make your first 90 days smoother.
   

  

* AI\-native product design. You have designed agents, copilots, chat, or automation workflows and know where the usual patterns break.
* AI in your own design process. You use it to move faster and explore wider, and you can show where it helped and where it did not.
* 0→1 experience. You have built something from nothing inside a startup or a new product line.
* Design systems. You have built or scaled one, and you understand the maintenance cost as well as the leverage.
* A view on AI trust and transparency. Agent behaviour, explainability, human\-in\-the\-loop control you have thought about what earns a user's confidence.


****Life at Lyzr****
* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company\-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem\-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.


****How to apply****
 Apply through our careers page at careers.lyzr.ai, or send your resume to hiring@lyzr.ai. Send your portfolio with it we read those first. Two or three case studies you can defend end to end will tell us more than a gallery of screens.

title: Product Design Intern
description:
Description
 


 Cravv is building the brain for the kitchen. A device that understands what is happening while you cook and guides you through it as it happens. We are a Tier 1 funded hardware startup in Bengaluru, and the first units are going into real homes. Nobody has built this before, so there is no product to reference and no template to follow. Everything you design here is the first version of it.
 





 The product is three things at once. A device, a mobile app, and an AI layer that reads the kitchen and decides what to say next. Very few designers get to work across all three, and almost nobody gets to this early.
 





 We move fast. We are in active testing, work goes live most weeks, and a decision takes one conversation.
 





 We are looking for a product design intern to help us figure it out.
 




 What you will actually work on
 


 Not moodboards. Not assisting a senior designer. Real parts of the product, owned end to end and shipped.
 



* **The device, and the app around it.** 

 Two surfaces with very different rules. Most designers do not get near hardware until much later, if ever.
* **An AI that sometimes gets it wrong.** 

 You decide what it says, when it stays quiet, and how it recovers from a bad guess. The hardest problem here, and the most interesting.
* **A design system you build, not inherit.** 

 You name things and decide what scales, then watch it hold up or break.
* **Features from zero.** 

 Talk to users, work out what they actually need, design the answer.
* **Work that ships.** 

 Feedback comes back in hours, not quarters. What you draw this morning can be in a kitchen tonight.
* **Real kitchens, not personas.** 

 Watch someone struggle with something you made, work out why, and fix it.
* **The small stuff.** 

 Components, states, micro\-interactions, motion. The details that decide whether it feels good.



 Who you will be working with
 


 A small, young team that ships every week. Average age is closer to yours than to your professor’s.
 





 No hierarchy, no design committee, no six\-week approvals. You show the work, we talk about it, it ships. You will be in the room where the decision gets made, not the one where it gets announced.
 





 We argue about details.
 




 What you get out of it
 

**Three to four months here is worth about two years elsewhere.** 

 A big company gives you one surface, one release a quarter, and a senior designer between you and the decision. Here you get three surfaces, a release most weeks, and the founders in the room. You will make more decisions and ship more work in a few months than most designers do in two years.
 




**A skillset almost nobody your age has.** 

 Hardware, mobile and AI in one product. You will leave able to say you have designed a physical interface, an app and an AI experience, with shipped work behind each.
 




**A stipend at par with industry standards.** 

 Paid monthly, on time. Exposure is not a currency.
 




**A recommendation letter from the founders,** 

 if things go well, based on work you actually shipped.
 




**A full\-time offer at the end,** 

 if the fit is right.
 




**Ownership that usually takes years to earn.** 

 Your name is on the thing. So are your mistakes. Both are useful.
 




**A portfolio piece nobody else has.** 

 Your case study starts with ‘I designed for a category that did not exist yet.’ It will be the first thing every future interviewer asks about.
 




 What we are looking for
 


 High agency, above everything else. You see something broken and you fix it without being asked. You do not wait for a brief, and nobody has to chase you. When something is unclear, you go and find out.
 





 After that:
 



* A portfolio with your best work. This is the main thing we look at
* Comfort when there is no obvious right answer
* Curiosity about people and about how things work
* Figma fluency and product thinking




 Interest in hardware or AI helps, but it is not a requirement. We can teach that part.
 





 We do not care about your college, your CGPA, or whether design was your original degree.
 




 To apply
 


 Send your portfolio to careers@cravv.in . Tell us briefly what you would want to work on here and why.
 





 More about us at www.cravv.in

 Optik Precision Instruments \- a leading name in industrial cameras, lights, lenses, and accessories for the machine vision industry \- is looking for an adaptable, detail\-oriented technical professional to streamline our product documentation and evolve into a key technical support and sales\-enablement specialist.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  





 This is a high\-growth role starting with a crucial internal foundation project: building a modern, organized system for our technical product documentation.

**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Phase 1 (Delhi NCR \- Initial \~3 months)Technical Documentation \& Data Management

* Work with internal engineering teams to translate complex hardware/software specifications into clear, professional customer\-facing documentation.
* Ensure consistent formatting, technical accuracy, and version control across all product literature.
* Phase 2 (Option of Delhi NCR or Bengaluru \- Full Time)Customer Support \& Sales Assistance
* Provide tier\-1 and tier\-2 technical support to customers' integration issues, hardware setups, and troubleshooting.
* Assist the sales team by analyzing customer application requirements, recommending suitable camera/lens/light combinations, and preparing technical proposals.

* Experience: 1 to 4 years of professional experience in an engineering, technical support, or technical writing role.

* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills. Advanced technical writing capability is non\-negotiable.
* Industry Background: Direct experience or strong familiarity with the Computer Vision, Machine Vision, Industrial Automation, or Optical/Photonics industries is highly preferred.
* Technical Aptitude: Ability to read technical drawings, understand optical/sensor specifications (e.g., resolution, focal length, interfaces like GigE/USB3\), and explain complex concepts simply.
* Mindset: Proactive, self\-organized, and eager to grow from a technical creation role into a customer\-facing problem solver.



  





**Why Join Optik Precision Instruments?** 




  




* Direct Impact: Build the technical foundation of our product documentation from the ground up.
* Career Growth: Clear progression path from documentation specialist to Application/Sales Support Engineer.

**How to Apply** 




  





 Submit your resume alongside a short writing sample or examples of technical documentation/manuals you have created or edited in past roles. The application process will also include a task to prepare a sample user manual or tech sheet for an example product.

description:
💻 Position: Enterprise Implementation Consultant
 



 📍Location: Gurugram
 



 🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Saturday (Alternate Saturday \- half day)
 



 📌 Experience Required: 1\-3 years
 



  





 In\-Office \+ Client Site \| Enterprise SaaS \| Construction Tech
 



 About Our Client
 



 Construction is a $13 trillion global industry — and one of the least digitised. Projects routinely overrun budgets and timelines because execution data lives in spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and the heads of site engineers. The cost of this opacity runs into millions on every project.
 



 Our Client is an AI\-powered Construction Management System that gives construction and infrastructure companies real\-time control, visibility, and predictability over project execution.
 



 Credentials:
 


* Backed by Y Combinator, Stellaris Venture Partners \& Zacua Ventures
* RICS SEA PropTech of the Year — 2024 \& 2025, ET Realty PropTech of the Year 2024, 2026
* Reference Customers: Amazon (India \& UAE), JSW Homes, The Fitout, LivSpace, Semac Construction, Blinkit, Table Space, Fortes Education,



 The Role
 



 We are hiring Enterprise Implementation Consultants to serve as the primary client\-facing interface for Our Client deployments at some of India’s most complex construction and infrastructure organisations.
 



**This is not a back\-office coordination role.** 




 You will be embedded on\-prem at enterprise client sites — operating inside organisations like Amazon, JSW, LivSpace, Blinkit, Table Space etc. Working under the direction of an experienced EIC Lead, your mandate is to translate client workflows into structured Our Client implementations, drive user adoption from Day 1, and serve as the trusted consultant bridging client operations and the Our Client product team.
 



 You will own on\-the\-ground execution: stakeholder engagement, training delivery, adoption tracking, process documentation, and continuous improvement — with direct support from a seasoned EIC Lead throughout.
 



 What You Will Own
 


* Client\-side implementation support — conducting workflow discovery sessions, mapping organisation structures, and assisting in configuring approval hierarchies and SOPs within Our Client
* Stakeholder engagement across department heads and on\-ground teams — building credibility, facilitating alignment, and maintaining momentum across the deployment lifecycle
* Training programme delivery — executing department\-wise and role\-specific training sessions, producing structured training materials, and driving hands\-on adoption from Day 1
* Adoption monitoring and reporting — tracking usage dashboards, auditing system activity, producing weekly adoption reports, and escalating non\-compliance to the EIC Lead with clear documentation
* Process documentation — preparing MOMs, SOPs, training schedules, and audit reports that are acted upon by client stakeholders
* Data coordination — supporting the migration and structuring of client data including BOQs, vendor masters, and rate contracts into Our Client
* Internal coordination — channelling client feedback and field observations to the EIC Lead and Our Client product team with clarity and context
* Continuous improvement — identifying workflow gaps and proposing improvements that increase platform utilisation and client ROI



 Who Should Apply
 


* 0–2 years of experience in client\-facing roles — SaaS implementation, customer success, technology consulting, or enterprise onboarding
* Exposure to construction, infrastructure, real estate, or asset\-heavy industries is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to engage independently with senior client stakeholders and navigate complex organisational environments
* Strong first\-principles thinking — you break problems into components, ask the right questions, and adapt when plans meet reality
* Excellent communication and documentation skills — your MOMs, SOPs, and training materials are clear, structured, and acted upon
* Data literacy and comfort with technology — advanced Excel, familiarity with dashboarding tools, and openness to learning SQL and Python
* High ownership and bias for action — you move fast, flag blockers early, and do not wait for instructions



 Ideal prior backgrounds include:
 


* Campus placements, internships, or early\-career stints in enterprise SaaS, management consulting, or technology services
* Operations, project coordination, or EIC support roles in construction, EPC, real estate, or field\-operations environments
* Customer\-facing roles in B2B product companies with structured onboarding or implementation components



 What This Role Is Not
 



 We want to be transparent about fit:
 


* This is not a remote or hybrid position. You will be deployed at client sites and Our Client offices across India. Domestic travel is a core part of the role.
* This is not a passive support role. You are not logging tickets or forwarding requests — you are accountable for the success of enterprise implementations on the ground.
* This is not a pure training or coordination role. You will engage directly with CXO and VP\-level stakeholders and be expected to hold your own in consultative conversations.
* This requires maturity, independence, and comfort operating in ambiguity — particularly when deploying software inside organisations where digital maturity is being built from scratch.



 Skills \& Competencies
 



 Must\-Have
 


* Client\-facing presence and communication — ability to run structured discovery sessions, present confidently to department heads, and maintain professional relationships on\-prem
* Documentation capability — MOMs, SOPs, training schedules, audit reports, and adoption dashboards that are clear and immediately usable
* Data literacy — advanced Excel, ability to structure and interpret operational data, and comfort working with reporting tools
* Organisational rigour — managing parallel workstreams across multiple stakeholders without dropping threads
* Escalation discipline — knowing when and how to surface blockers to the EIC Lead and client leadership with the right context



 Strong Advantages
 


* SQL proficiency and ability to run basic analytical queries
* Familiarity with dashboarding tools such as Grafana, Metabase, or Power BI
* Exposure to workflow automation, AI agents, or no\-code/low\-code platforms
* Understanding of construction workflows: BOQ management, DPR, procurement cycles, vendor coordination, and site operations
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Figma, Whimsical, or Notion for process documentation and project mapping
* Working knowledge of business software ecosystems including accounting platforms (Tally), project management tools (Zoho Projects), and CRM systems — with an understanding of how these interact with a construction management platform in an enterprise environment
* Hands\-on experience configuring or managing integrations between enterprise tools — including field mapping, data transformation, and workflow handoffs across systems such as ERP, CRM, and communication platforms (e.g. Meta Business Suite, WhatsApp API)
* Ability to design and document end\-to\-end operational workflows — mapping process steps, decision nodes, roles, and system touchpoints with precision; experience translating client workflows into structured platform configurations is a strong plus

title: Global People Analytics Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


As a Senior Analyst, you’ll support evidenced\-based decision making. You’ll provide analytical input to support the Global People team and work with stakeholders across BCG. You’ll add a quantitative perspective to discussions on new and existing HR processes and procedures

  

You will apply an analytics mindset and empower internal clients with dashboards, data, and reports to help improve processes, and solve people related challenges, to provide thought leadership on the complete cycle of talent analytics, from sourcing the candidates to managing attrition

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, design, and manage advanced Tableau and Power BI dashboards that integrate data from diverse sources
* Use SQL to query databases and retrieve relevant data for analysis and reporting
  

Perform data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) to create efficient and scalable data models
* Thought partner with internal stakeholders on various people related challenges, by developing domain expertise
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency through rigorous testing and quality checks
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements and understand data sources

  

What You'll Bring

* Undergraduate degree, preferably in an engineering or other technology\-related fields, with high academic achievement required; advanced degree preferred
* MUST HAVES: 5\-7 years of full time Tableau and Power BI dashboard development, data modeling, and SQL language expertise
* Advanced Tableau experience, including Tableau server management, level of detail calculations, built custom charts, hyper data source, Javascript APIs
* Advanced Power BI skills, with a focus on dashboard development including DAX calculations, custom visualizations, and Power Query
* Strong understanding of UX/UI principles for creating intuitive and visually impactful Tableau dashboards
* Knowledge in SQL for querying databases, optimizing data retrieval, and supporting data\-driven decision\-making
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, with skills in data manipulation, including sorting, filtering, and using formulas to analyze and organize complex data sets
* Background in HR data analysis and HR domain knowledge is preferred, however not mandatory
* Deep interest and aptitude in data, metrics, and analysis

  

Who You'll Work With

  

* As part of the Global People analytics team, you will modernize HR platforms, capabilities \& engagement, automate/digitize core HR processes and operations and enable greater efficiency. You will collaborate with the global people teams and colleagues across BCG to manage the life cycle of all BCG employees.
* The People Management Team (PMT) is comprised of several centers of expertise including HR Operations, People Analytics, Career Development, Learning \& Development, Talent Acquisition \& Branding, Compensation, and Mobility. Our centers of expertise work together to build out new teams and capabilities by sourcing, acquiring and retaining the best, diverse talent for BCG.
* We develop talent and capabilities, while enhancing managers’ effectiveness, and building affiliation and engagement in our global offices. The PMT also harmonizes process efficiencies, automation, and global standardization. Through analytics and digitalization, we are always looking to expand our PMT capabilities and coverage.

  

Additional info

**You are good at**

* Providing analytical support in metrics, reporting, and dashboard development
* Leading technical aspects of a large project with minimal supervision
* Generating insights from large and complex datasets, and understanding the nuances and inconsistencies in data
* Ability to multi\-task and operate effectively in a fast\-paced and customer\-oriented environment; ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a matrix organization
* Communicating and presenting technical details to non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong interpersonal skills, who showcases credibility and excels in a collaborative setting


At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

  

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

  

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**About the Institute** 




 Uttaranchal Dental \& Medical Research Institute (UDMRI), established in 2006, is a dental and allied health sciences institution in Dehradun, affiliated to Hemwati Nandan Bahuguna Uttarakhand Medical Education University. It offers BDS, MDS, BMLT and BMRIT programmes and runs a 100\-bed on\-campus hospital for clinical training and community healthcare.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The HR Manager will lead the complete HR function for the college and its attached hospital, covering teaching faculty, doctors, nursing and paramedical staff, and administrative and support employees. The role ensures the institute always has qualified people in place as required by regulatory norms, stays compliant with labour laws, and builds a fair, engaged and professional workplace.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Talent Acquisition \& Faculty Planning** 



* Prepare annual manpower plans for each department in line with DCI / National Dental Commission and university norms for sanctioned intake (BDS, MDS and allied courses).
* Run end\-to\-end hiring for faculty (Professors, Readers, Senior Lecturers), resident doctors, nursing, paramedical, technical and administrative staff.
* Verify teaching experience, degrees, council registrations and cadre eligibility before appointment.
* Coordinate selection committees, interviews and demo lectures; issue offer and appointment letters.



**2\. Regulatory Compliance \& Inspections** 



* Maintain complete, up\-to\-date faculty and staff records for DCI/NDC, university and state inspections.
* Monitor faculty attendance systems (including Aadhaar\-enabled biometric attendance where mandated) and flag shortfalls in advance.
* Ensure staffing ratios, faculty rosters and supporting documents meet prescribed standards.
* Support hospital accreditation needs (e.g., NABH HR standards) such as credentialing and training records.



**3\. Statutory \& Labour Law Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and Labour Codes, including EPF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, minimum wages and maternity benefit.
* Constitute and support the Internal Committee under the POSH Act.
* Liaise with labour department, PF/ESI offices, auditors and legal advisors; maintain statutory registers and filings.



**4\. HR Operations \& Payroll** 



* Manage joining formalities, induction, personnel files, service books and HRIS records.
* Oversee attendance, leave, duty rosters and monthly payroll inputs in coordination with Accounts.
* Administer increments, promotions, confirmations, contract renewals and full\-and\-final settlements.



**5\. Performance, Development \& Employee Relations** 



* Implement annual appraisals for faculty and non\-teaching staff.
* Coordinate faculty development programmes, CDE/CME sessions and patient\-care training.
* Handle grievances, disciplinary matters and domestic enquiries fairly and in line with service rules.
* Drive engagement and retention; conduct exit interviews and analyse attrition.



**6\. Policy \& Reporting** 



* Draft and implement HR policies, service rules, code of conduct and SOPs.
* Provide monthly MIS on headcount, vacancies, attrition, compliance status and HR costs to management.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* MBA / PGDM (HR) or MSW (HR / Labour Welfare) from a recognised university; LLB or labour\-law certification is a plus.
* 8–12 years of HR experience, with at least 3–4 years in a dental/medical college, teaching hospital or higher\-education institution.
* Working knowledge of DCI/NDC faculty norms and inspection processes strongly preferred.



**Skills** 



* Strong knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Proven ability to hire and retain senior academic and clinical professionals.
* Excellent documentation and attention to detail; proficient in MS Excel and HRIS/payroll software.
* Clear communication in English and Hindi; high integrity and discretion.



  





**Location:** 
 UDMRI Campus, Mazri Grant, Haridwar Road, Dehradun (on\-site, full\-time)
 



**Compensation:** 
 Commensurate with qualification and experience
 



 UDMRI is an equal opportunity employer.

 Manager – Human Resources

 Human Resources

 Minimum 5\+ Years

**About BeFiSc** 


 BeFiSc is a financial data intelligence and risk technology company helping businesses make safer, faster, and smarter decisions. We work with organizations across FinTech, BFSI, Insurance, Digital Lending, and Financial Services.
 





 Our core focus is Fraud Prevention, Risk Analysis, and Financial Data Intelligence. Using technology, APIs, data analytics, and large\-scale data processing, we help businesses detect suspicious patterns, assess customer and transaction risks, verify identities and businesses, and turn complex financial data into actionable insights.
 





 Our solutions support critical use cases including customer onboarding, underwriting, fraud detection, identity and employment verification, financial analysis, due diligence, and risk monitoring.
 



**Role Overview** 


 We are looking for an experienced HR Manager to lead and strengthen the Human Resources function at BeFiSc. The candidate must have minimum 5\+ years of HR experience, with prior exposure to the FinTech/BFSI industry and hands\-on experience working in a technology\-driven company.
 





 The HR Manager will be responsible for the complete employee lifecycle, including talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, retention, HR operations, policies, compliance, and organizational development.
 





 The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-growing technology environment and partnering closely with Founders, Leadership, Engineering, Product, Sales, Operations, Support, Finance, and Information Security teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 
1. Own and manage the end\-to\-end HR function for the organization.
2. Lead recruitment across Engineering, Product, Information Security, Data, Sales, Operations, Customer Support, Finance, and other business functions.
3. Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle including manpower planning, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, salary negotiation, offer rollout, and joining.
4. Build strong hiring pipelines using LinkedIn, Naukri, job portals, employee referrals, consultants, recruitment agencies, and other sourcing channels.

12. Coordinate payroll, attendance, leave management, employee documentation, HRMS, and employee records.
13. Track HR metrics including Hiring TAT, Offer\-to\-Joining Ratio, Attrition Rate, Retention Rate, Cost per Hire, Employee Turnover, and Recruitment Funnel Performance.
14. Conduct regular HR reviews and provide meaningful HR dashboards and reports to management.
15. Partner directly with leadership on workforce planning, organizational structure, compensation, succession planning, and HR strategy.
16. Build scalable HR processes suitable for a fast\-growing FinTech and technology organization.


**Required Skills** 
* Strong experience in Talent Acquisition and Technical Hiring.
* Understanding of technology roles and technical skill sets.
* Strong knowledge of employee lifecycle management.
* Experience in performance management and KRA/KPI frameworks.
* Strong employee engagement and retention capabilities.
* Knowledge of HR policies, labour laws, POSH, and statutory compliance.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle employee grievances and sensitive situations professionally.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience with HRMS, ATS, Excel, and Google Sheets.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and execution capabilities.

* Prior experience in the FinTech/BFSI industry is required/preferred.
* Must have experience working in a technology/software/SaaS/API/product\-driven company.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources will be preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in both technical and non\-technical recruitment.
* Experience independently managing multiple HR functions.
* Experience working directly with senior management and business leaders.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred or Good to Have** 
* Experience working in a FinTech startup or high\-growth technology company.
* Experience scaling an organization and building HR processes from the ground up.
* Experience hiring Software Engineers, Tech Leads, DevOps, QA, Data Engineers, Product Managers, Information Security, Sales and Operations professionals.
* Understanding of FinTech, Digital Lending, BFSI, APIs, SaaS, financial data, or risk technology.
* Experience implementing or managing HRMS/ATS platforms.
* Experience building HR dashboards and management reports.
* Exposure to employee learning and development programs.
* Experience managing organizational restructuring and change management.

**Key Performance Areas** 
* Quality and timely closure of hiring requirements.
* Recruitment TAT and offer\-to\-joining conversion.
* Quality of technical and non\-technical hiring.
* Employee retention and attrition management.
* Effective onboarding and employee lifecycle management.
* Timely execution of performance reviews and appraisal cycles.
* Employee engagement and workplace satisfaction.
* Accuracy and compliance of HR operations and documentation.
* Quality of HR reporting and management dashboards.
* Effective resolution of employee concerns and grievances.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

 The candidate should understand both the FinTech business environment and technology workforce, and should be capable of recruiting and managing employees across technical and business functions.

description:

 Join the dynamic team at
 **Wholsum Foods** 
 and be part of an extraordinary movement!
   

  

 Our mission is simple:
 **to change the world's eats.** 
 With brands like
 **Slurrp Farm and Mille** 
 , we offer healthy and delicious alternatives to the junk food epidemic. It’s time to rediscover the nutritious traditions of our ancestors and embrace the power of millets like Ragi, Jowar, Bajra and Foxtail Millet.
   

  

 Led by founders
 **Shauravi Malik and Meghana Narayan** 
 , we are food enthusiasts, entrepreneurs and mothers committed to making a difference. We’re expanding globally and looking for people who thrive in a collaborative, innovative and high\-growth environment.
   

  

 At Wholsum Foods, we believe our team is our greatest asset. Our core values —
 **Relationship First, Dependable, Passionate and Growth Mindset** 
 — shape how we work and how we grow together.
   

  

 We are also
 **Great Place to Work Certified** 
 .
   

  

 If you enjoy being close to the business, solving real people challenges and building things rather than just following playbooks, you’ll enjoy this role.
   

  

 WHAT WILL YOU DO AT WHOLSUM FOODS?
   

  

 As a
 **Manager – HR Business Partner** 
 , you will be a strategic and hands\-on people partner to our business leaders.
   

  

 You will work closely with leaders and managers to understand where the business is headed, what the organisation needs to get there, and how HR can enable that journey.
   

  

 This is not a role limited to HR processes. You will be expected to understand the
 **business, people, numbers and culture** 
 , and translate business priorities into meaningful people actions.
   

  

 You will own the HR agenda for assigned functions across
 **workforce planning, talent acquisition, performance, talent management, employee engagement, organisation effectiveness and employee lifecycle** 
 , while partnering closely with leadership on critical people decisions.
   

  

 The role requires someone who is equally comfortable discussing
 **business targets with a leader, solving an employee concern, challenging a hiring manager, analysing people data or getting into the details to make something happen.**
**Job Purpose**
 To partner with business leaders in building a high\-performing organisation by translating business priorities into effective people strategies and ensuring strong execution across the employee lifecycle.
   

  

 The Manager – HRBP will act as a
 **thought partner to the business** 
 , while remaining deeply hands\-on in execution.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business Partnering
* Partner with business leaders to understand their business plans, organisation structure, workforce requirements and people challenges.
* Act as a trusted HR advisor and thought partner to leaders and managers.
* Translate business priorities into people priorities and actionable HR plans.
* Proactively identify people risks and opportunities rather than only responding to issues.
* Challenge and influence managers where required, while maintaining strong relationships and credibility.
* Understand business metrics and connect people decisions with business outcomes.
* Workforce Planning \& Organisation Effectiveness
* Partner with leaders on annual and periodic workforce planning.
* Assess organisation structures, spans, layers, capability requirements and future talent needs.
* Support manpower planning based on business growth, productivity and cost considerations.
* Identify capability gaps and work with leaders to build the right talent and organisation structure.
* Support organisation design and restructuring initiatives as the business evolves.
* Talent Acquisition
* Partner with Talent Acquisition on critical and leadership hiring requirements.
* Support role calibration, talent benchmarking and hiring strategy for assigned functions.
* Ensure hiring plans are aligned with business priorities, timelines and budgets.
* Bring a business lens to candidate quality, compensation and talent availability.
* Build strong understanding of internal and external talent pipelines.
* Performance \& Talent Management
* Own and strengthen performance management practices for assigned teams.
* Partner with managers on goal setting, performance reviews, feedback and performance improvement.
* Support talent reviews, succession planning and identification of high\-potential talent.
* Enable managers to have better quality performance and career conversations.
* Identify capability gaps and work with the People Team to create relevant development interventions.
* Employee Engagement \& Culture
* Actively own the employee experience for assigned functions.
* Use employee feedback, engagement data and people insights to identify areas of improvement.
* Partner with managers to strengthen engagement, retention and team effectiveness.
* Drive meaningful employee connects and culture initiatives rather than activity\-led engagement.
* Be a strong custodian of Wholsum’s values and culture as the organisation scales.
* Employee Relations \& Manager Enablement
* Act as a point of support for managers and employees on people\-related matters.
* Handle sensitive employee situations with maturity, empathy and sound judgement.
* Coach managers on employee conversations, conflict resolution, performance concerns and people decisions.
* Ensure consistent and fair application of HR policies and processes.
* Build manager capability to independently handle people matters effectively.
* People Analytics \& Insights
* Use people data to identify trends and support business decisions.
* Track metrics such as attrition, hiring TAT, workforce cost, engagement, performance and retention.
* Convert people data into meaningful insights and recommendations for leadership.
* Build a data\-backed approach to solving recurring people challenges.
* HR Projects \& Organisation Building
* Lead and contribute to strategic People \& Culture projects as the organisation scales.
* Build and improve HR processes, frameworks and systems with a focus on simplicity and effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to use technology and AI to improve HR productivity and employee experience.
* Drive projects from idea to execution, ensuring measurable outcomes.


**What Success Looks Like**
 In this role, success will mean:
   

  

* Business leaders see you as a trusted people partner, not just an HR process owner.
* Workforce plans are aligned with business growth and cost priorities.
* Hiring, retention and talent decisions are increasingly proactive and data\-backed.
* Managers become better at managing, developing and engaging their teams.
* Performance and talent processes are executed with quality and ownership.
* People issues are identified early and resolved thoughtfully.
* Employees have a strong and consistent experience across their lifecycle.
* HR is seen as an enabler of business growth, not a support function sitting on the sidelines.


**Experience Required**
* 9–12 years of relevant experience across HR Business Partnering, HR Generalist, Talent Management, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations or related HR roles.
* Strong experience in business partnering with managers and senior business leaders.
* Experience working in a startup, D2C, FMCG, food, retail, consumer or other high\-growth environment will be preferred.
* Strong exposure to multiple HR areas, with the ability to look at people challenges holistically.
* Demonstrated experience in handling complex people situations and influencing stakeholders.
* Experience in workforce planning, performance management, talent management and employee engagement.
* Strong understanding of HR metrics and people analytics.


**What We Are Looking For**
 Business Acumen
   

  

 You understand that HR decisions ultimately need to support the business. You are curious about revenue, growth, productivity, cost and organisational performance.
   

  

 Ownership
   

  

 You don’t wait for perfect instructions. You identify the problem, figure out what needs to happen and drive it to closure.
   

  

 Stakeholder Management
   

  

 You can build trust with people at different levels while also having the confidence to challenge when required.
   

  

 People Judgement
   

  

 You can balance empathy with business realities and make thoughtful decisions in sensitive situations.
   

  

 Execution Excellence
   

  

 You can think strategically but are equally comfortable getting into the details and making things happen.
   

  

 Growth Mindset
   

  

 You enjoy ambiguity, learn quickly and are excited by the opportunity to build rather than simply maintain existing systems.
   

  

 Data Orientation
   

  

 You are comfortable using data and people insights to understand problems, challenge assumptions and make better decisions.
   

  

**Academic Requirements**
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources is preferred.
* Candidates with a bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Commerce or a related discipline may also be considered.


 WHAT WILL YOU GET?
   

  

* A front\-row seat to building a high\-growth FMCG business.
* Opportunity to work closely with founders, business leaders and senior People \& Culture leaders.
* The opportunity to shape the people agenda as Wholsum scales.
* Exposure to strategic workforce planning, organisation building and business decision\-making.
* Freedom to experiment, build and improve rather than simply follow established playbooks.
* Mentorship from senior leaders, board members and in\-house experts.
* The opportunity to think strategically while staying close to execution.
* A chance to make a real impact on how people experience and grow with Wholsum Foods.


**STARTING DATE:** 
 Position open immediately
   

  

**LOCATION:** 
 Golf Course Road, Gurugram
   

  

**WORKING MODEL:** 
 5\-day working week \| Wednesday WFH
   

  

 Wholsum Foods is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity in its workforce.

description:
**About The Team**
 Our HR team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high\-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world\-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought\-after e\-commerce destinations.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced HR professional to lead two equally important charters: HR Business Partnering for the 3P/contract workforce and Employee Relations.
   

  

 The role will manage a team of 6 direct reports supporting office, work\-from\-home, and field\-based employees across multiple businesses and locations. The incumbent will partner closely with Business Leaders, HR Leadership, Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Payroll, Ethics and Investigations, and staffing partners.
   

  

 The role requires strong business understanding, people leadership, ER expertise, data\-driven decision\-making, and the ability to manage complex and sensitive matters with fairness, maturity, and speed.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Partner with Business Leaders and Finance teams on workforce planning, headcount budgeting, organizational design, productivity, cost optimization, and workforce deployment.


* Maintain visibility on headcount, hiring, vacancies, redeployments, contract renewals, non\-renewals, attrition, organizational structure, and workforce costs.
* Partner with managers on performance management, talent development, succession planning, retention, and performance improvement plans.
* Use workforce data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities and recommend appropriate business and people interventions.
* Lead the Employee Relations charter across businesses and locations, ensuring fair, consistent, and timely resolution of employee concerns.
* Manage complex cases involving misconduct, fraud, harassment, absenteeism, behavioural concerns, conflicts of interest, dual employment, bribery, and policy violations.
* Lead or oversee workplace investigations, including complaint assessment, interviews, evidence review, documentation, findings, and recommendations.
* Partner with Legal, Ethics and Investigations, POSH committees, Business Leaders, and HR Leadership on complex or high\-risk matters.
* Guide HRBPs and managers on grievance handling, corrective action, disciplinary processes, performance concerns, and sensitive employee conversations.
* Ensure ER decisions follow organizational policies, applicable laws, principles of natural justice, and established precedents.
* Provide governance oversight for hiring, onboarding, background verification, attendance, payroll inputs, insurance, contract renewals, and exits.
* Monitor compliance with minimum wages, statutory requirements, labour laws, contractor obligations, and internal policies.
* Conduct periodic audits, review vendor performance, and strengthen SOPs, controls, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.
* Lead, coach, and develop six direct reports across the HRBP and ER charters, with clear goals, accountability, and operating rhythms.
* Build team capability in business partnering, investigations, documentation, data analysis, labour\-law compliance, and stakeholder management.
* Review key deliverables and escalations while enabling team members to independently manage their respective businesses and responsibilities.


**What You Will Need**
* 6 \- 10 years of progressive HR experience, with significant exposure to both HR Business Partnering and Employee Relations.


* Experience managing a large, distributed contract, third\-party, fixed\-term, field, operations, or high\-volume workforce.
* Proven experience handling complex ER cases, workplace investigations, disciplinary actions, grievances, performance concerns, and fraud\-related matters.
* Strong experience partnering with senior leaders on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, performance, talent, and attrition.
* Good understanding of labour laws, statutory compliance, minimum wages, contractor governance, and audit requirements.
* Experience managing staffing partners and governing employee\-lifecycle processes.
* Prior experience leading and developing an HRBP or ER team is essential.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, conflict resolution, investigation, documentation, and data\-analysis capabilities.
* Sound judgment, high ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to handle confidential matters independently.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and high\-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel and support teams across multiple locations.
* MBA/PGDM or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Human Resources. Certification in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, POSH, or workplace investigations will be an added advantage.

title: Senior Manager - Human Resource Business Partner
description:
The Senior Manager/ Manager – Human Resources will be responsible for partnering with the Retail Business and Store Operations teams across North, Upper North of India to drive the people agenda and ensure effective execution of HR policies, processes and initiatives across the region.
   

  

 The role will act as a strategic and hands\-on HR Business Partner to Regional/District leadership, Store Managers and retail teams, providing HR guidance across the complete employee lifecycle including workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, employee engagement, performance management, employee relations, capability development, career progression and succession planning.
   

  

 The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring that HR practices are consistently implemented across stores while balancing business requirements with Skechers' people policies, values and employment practices.
   

  

 The role requires strong field presence, excellent stakeholder management skills, sound knowledge of employment legislation and the ability to independently manage complex employee relations matters across a geographically dispersed retail workforce.
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Senior Manager
   

  

**Role:** 
 HRBP (North \& Upper North)
   

  

**Function:** 
 Human Resources
   

  

**Business:** 
 Retail – Skechers India
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi (CP)
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Senior General Manger \- HR
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* HR Business Partnership – Retail
* Partner closely with Regional/District Managers, Store Managers and Retail Operations leadership to understand business priorities and translate them into effective people strategies.
* Act as the primary HR point of contact for the assigned region and provide timely, practical and business\-oriented HR solutions.
* Drive the implementation of HR policies, processes and initiatives across all stores within the region.
* Maintain strong working relationships with store management, field leadership, retail operations and corporate HR teams.
* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of HR policies across locations.
* Provide HR insights and recommendations to business leaders based on people trends, workforce data and business requirements.
* Maintain strong HR visibility across stores through regular field visits and interactions with employees and managers.
* Employee Relations \& Conflict Resolution
* Own and manage employee relations matters across the assigned region, ensuring fair, consistent and timely resolution.
* Partner with store and regional management teams on employee grievances, disciplinary matters, workplace conflicts and behavioral concerns.
* Investigate employee complaints and concerns objectively, ensuring appropriate documentation and confidentiality.
* Advise managers on appropriate courses of action in relation to employee relations matters.
* Support disciplinary processes, including counselling, warning letters, performance\-related actions and other corrective measures in line with company policies.
* Maintain accurate documentation of employee relations cases, investigations, actions and resolutions.
* Identify recurring employee relations issues and recommend preventive measures to business and HR leadership.
* Escalate sensitive or high\-risk matters to the appropriate HR and leadership stakeholders.
* Recruitment \& Workforce Planning
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and Retail Operations to understand manpower requirements and workforce plans across the region.
* Support timely hiring for stores and ensure manpower availability in line with business requirements.
* Train and guide Store Managers on effective interviewing and selection practices in accordance with Skechers standards.
* Participate in the selection of key retail positions and provide HR inputs on candidate suitability.
* Monitor staffing levels, vacancies, attrition and manpower productivity across the region.
* Identify recurring hiring challenges and work with TA and business teams to develop appropriate solutions.
* Support workforce planning for new store openings, expansions, replacements and seasonal requirements.
* Performance Management
* Drive effective implementation of the performance management process across the region.
* Guide Store Managers and Regional/District Managers on goal setting, performance reviews, feedback and performance improvement.
* Coach managers on handling underperformance and developing appropriate performance improvement plans where required.
* Monitor completion and quality of performance reviews across the region.
* Identify high performers and critical talent in partnership with business leaders.
* Support the creation of individual development plans for identified talent and high\-potential employees.
* Career Progression \& Succession Planning
* Drive career development and internal mobility initiatives across the retail workforce.
* Identify high\-potential employees and critical talent in collaboration with business leadership.
* Support the development and maintenance of succession plans for key retail positions, including Store Managers and other critical roles.
* Create talent pipelines for future leadership requirements across the region.
* Partner with L\&D to identify capability gaps and recommend relevant development interventions.
* Facilitate career conversations and encourage internal growth opportunities.
* Monitor internal movements, promotions and readiness of identified successors.
* Learning \& Development
* Partner with the L\&D team to identify training and capability\-building requirements across stores.
* Assess training needs based on business performance, employee feedback, performance reviews and manager inputs.
* Support implementation of leadership, behavioral, product and functional training initiatives.
* Coach Store Managers and retail leaders on people management, employee relations, interviewing and performance management.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of training interventions and recommend improvements.
* Employee Engagement \& Retention
* Drive employee engagement initiatives across the region in partnership with the HR and Retail teams.
* Identify key drivers of employee engagement and attrition through regular store visits, employee interactions and HR data.
* Develop and implement initiatives to improve employee experience and retention.
* Conduct regular connect sessions with Store Managers and employees to understand concerns and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Partner with business leaders to address key engagement and retention challenges.
* Support recognition initiatives and reinforce a positive employee culture across the retail network.
* HR Policy, Compliance \& Employment Legislation
* Ensure adherence to Skechers policies, processes and employment practices across all stores.
* Maintain working knowledge of applicable state\-specific employment laws, labour regulations and statutory requirements relevant to retail operations.
* Guide managers on the appropriate application of employment legislation and company policies.
* Ensure statutory and employment\-related notices, policies and information are appropriately displayed at stores, wherever applicable.
* Partner with the Legal/Compliance and HR teams on employment\-related regulatory matters.
* Identify potential compliance risks and ensure timely escalation and corrective action.
* Support implementation of workplace health, safety and employment\-related requirements across stores.
* HR Reporting \& Analytics
* Prepare and analyze regional HR reports covering key people metrics.
* Track and report on:
+ Headcount and manpower availability
+ Attrition and retention
+ Hiring and vacancies
+ Internal movements and promotions
+ Performance management
+ Employee relations cases
+ Absenteeism
+ Training and development
+ Engagement initiatives

* Analyze trends and provide actionable insights to Retail and HR leadership.
* Use HR data to identify potential people risks and recommend interventions.
* Compensation \& HR Governance
* Monitor regional compensation guidelines and ensure adherence to approved salary structures and policies.
* Review compensation exceptions and provide recommendations based on business requirements and internal equity.
* Partner with HR leadership and relevant stakeholders on compensation\-related decisions.
* Ensure consistency and governance in people practices across the region.
* Store Visits \& Field HR Presence
* Travel extensively across the assigned region to maintain strong HR visibility and connect with employees and managers.
* Conduct regular store visits to understand employee experience, operational challenges and people\-related issues.
* Conduct HR audits/checks to ensure adherence to HR policies and processes.
* Interact with Store Managers, sales associates and retail leadership to understand ground\-level challenges.
* Provide on\-the\-ground coaching and support to store leadership teams.
* Ensure that HR initiatives are effectively translated from corporate strategy to store\-level execution.
* Stakeholder Management
* Build strong and productive relationships with:
+ Retail Operations
+ Regional/District Managers
+ Store Managers
+ Talent Acquisition
+ Learning \& Development
+ Compensation \& Benefits
+ HR Operations
+ Legal \& Compliance
+ Finance and other corporate functions

* Serve as a trusted HR advisor to business leaders.
* Balance employee advocacy with business requirements and organizational priorities.
* Demonstrate strong influencing and negotiation skills when dealing with complex people matters.
* HR Projects \& Process Improvements
* Lead and participate in regional and organization\-wide HR projects as assigned.
* Identify opportunities to simplify and improve HR processes within the retail environment.
* Support the implementation of new HR policies, systems and initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement in the retail employee experience.
* Ensure timely execution and completion of assigned HR projects.


**KEY SUCCESS PARAMETERS / KPIs**
**Success In This Role Will Be Measured Through**
* Regional attrition and retention levels.
* Timely closure of retail vacancies and manpower availability.
* Employee relations case management and resolution timelines.
* Effective implementation of performance management processes.
* Store\-level HR compliance and policy adherence.
* Employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* Internal promotions and career progression within the region.
* Succession coverage for critical retail positions.
* Training and capability development outcomes.
* Effectiveness of HR interventions and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Quality and frequency of field HR engagement.
* Accuracy and timeliness of HR reporting and analytics.
* Successful execution of HR projects and initiatives.


**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION**
* Postgraduate degree/MBA in Human Resources / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations from a reputed institution.
* Additional qualifications in Labour Laws / Employment Relations will be an advantage.


**Experience**
* 10–14 years of overall HR experience, with significant experience in an HR Business Partnering role.
* Prior experience in retail, fashion, footwear, apparel, FMCG, hospitality or another large frontline workforce environment is strongly preferred.
* Strong hands\-on experience in employee relations, performance management, workforce planning and people management.
* Experience managing HR across a large, geographically dispersed store/network environment is preferred.
* Proven experience partnering with senior retail/business stakeholders.


**Knowledge \& Skills**
**Functional Skills**
* HR Business Partnering
* Employee Relations
* Retail HR / Field HR
* Performance Management
* Talent Management
* Succession Planning
* Career Development
* Workforce Planning
* Employee Engagement \& Retention
* Recruitment \& Selection
* Learning \& Development
* Compensation \& Benefits
* HR Analytics \& Reporting
* Employment/Labour Laws
* HR Policy \& Compliance


**Behavioral Competencies**
* Strong business acumen
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Strong influencing and stakeholder management capability
* Sound judgement and decision\-making ability
* Conflict resolution and problem\-solving skills
* High level of confidentiality and integrity
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
* Strong coaching and people management skills
* Data\-driven approach to HR decision\-making
* Adaptability and ability to work in a fast\-paced retail environment


**TRAVEL REQUIREMENT**
 The role requires
 **extensive travel across North \& Upper North India** 
 , including regular visits to stores and regional locations based on business requirements.
   

  

 The incumbent should be comfortable working in a highly field\-oriented environment and engaging directly with employees and retail leadership across multiple locations.
   

  

**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**
 The ideal candidate will be a
 **strong, business\-oriented Retail HRBP** 
 who combines strategic HR thinking with hands\-on field execution. The candidate should be comfortable working closely with Store Managers and Regional/District leaders, managing complex employee relations situations, driving people processes across a distributed workforce and influencing business decisions through strong HR insights.
   

  

 The individual should have the maturity and confidence to operate as a
 **trusted advisor to Retail leadership** 
 , while maintaining strong employee connect and ensuring consistent implementation of Skechers' policies, culture and people practices across the region.

 Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e\-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

* Drive ALIV’s culture on ground: team rituals, communication norms, feedback loops, and basic engagement activities.

* High ownership role with direct access to management.
* Clear SOPs, structure, and room to build systems from scratch.
* Growth path to HR Ops Lead based on performance.
